headline: Samsung Wallet will open **USDC transfers to US Galaxy users** and Anchorage bought Routable, while Circle, Ripple and Standard Chartered bought into **OKX at a $25bn valuation**. In Europe, ESMA gave licensed platforms three months to drop unauthorised stablecoins.
mix_text: 8 launches · 7 partnerships · 4 funding rounds · 4 regulatory actions · 1 M&A deal
highlights: Circle, Ripple, QRT and SC Ventures invested in OKX on 7 October at an unchanged $25bn valuation, with RLUSD joining OKX's order book.
Samsung said on 7 October that eligible US Galaxy users can send USDC from Samsung Wallet from late October.
Anchorage Digital bought payouts platform Routable on 6 October, as more crypto firms sought OCC trust bank charters.
ESMA told MiCA-licensed firms on 8 October to stop serving unauthorised stablecoins and clear exposures within three months.
Agent payments spread as Oobit let AI assistants spend users' stablecoins through one-time cards on 9 October.

events.title: Oobit lets AI assistants spend users' stablecoins via one-time cards
events.summary: Oobit launched AI Payments, letting assistants such as Grok and Muse pay with a user's stablecoins, including USDT, through single-use cards, with the user approving each purchase. Eligible users in over 75 countries can connect.

events.title: NCUA proposes stablecoin data fields for credit union call reports
events.summary: The US credit union regulator proposed 26 new call-report fields on payment stablecoin activity, most on custody of keys, others on reserves held for issuers and exposures. It targets March 2027 reporting; comments close 8 December.

events.title: Nium to run fiat payouts for RedotPay's stablecoin users
events.summary: Cross-border payments firm Nium will provide the fiat off-ramp for RedotPay, letting its users turn stablecoins into local currency paid to bank accounts, wallets or cards across a network spanning 190 countries.

events.title: London's IMMIX raises about €3.1m for non-dollar stablecoin FX
events.summary: IMMIX, which converts between stablecoins in different currencies for payment firms, raised roughly €3.1m from Crane Ventures, BTSE and Portfolio Ventures, after an earlier seed led by MassMutual Ventures with Ripple taking part.

round.use_of_funds: pricing engine, liquidity and partner distribution

events.title: Bringin opens beta of euro business accounts taking stablecoins
events.summary: Bringin began an invite-only beta giving firms in 30 European countries a virtual IBAN with SEPA plus bitcoin, Lightning and stablecoin acceptance and self-custodied keys, running on Lightspark's MiCA-authorised European unit.

events.title: Visa and Abu Dhabi's ADI Foundation agree to explore on-chain payments
events.summary: Visa agreed to explore digital payments and infrastructure for digital asset transactions with ADI Foundation, the ADGM-registered body behind ADI Chain, a stablecoin-focused network aimed at MENA. No products or dates were set.

events.title: ESMA sets three-month wind-down for unauthorised stablecoin services
events.summary: ESMA told national supervisors that MiCA-licensed firms should stop serving EU clients in stablecoins that are not MiCA-compliant, keeping only wind-down services such as selling, withdrawing or safekeeping, with leftover exposure cleared within three months.

events.title: Circle, Ripple and StanChart buy into OKX at a $25bn valuation
events.summary: Circle, Ripple, quant firm QRT and Standard Chartered's SC Ventures invested in OKX at an unchanged $25bn valuation; the size was not disclosed. Ripple is adding RLUSD to OKX's order book, and OKX plans to tokenise real-world assets.

round.use_of_funds: growth and real-world asset tokenisation

events.title: Yuno adds Coinbase stablecoin checkout for its merchants
events.summary: Payment orchestrator Yuno became the first global commerce orchestration partner for Coinbase Payments Acceptance, letting its merchants switch on one-click stablecoin checkout without extra development work.

events.title: Polygon adds TRON's USDT to its Open Money Stack payments platform
events.summary: Polygon Labs added TRON support to Open Money Stack, so payment firms can take bank, card or cash funds, convert them into USDT on TRON, move it across EVM chains and pay out to bank accounts through a single integration.

events.title: World Liberty and Mesh plan USD1 spending at online merchants
events.summary: Mesh and World Liberty Financial plan to let USD1 holders pay across Mesh's online merchant network, with rollout targeted for this quarter. The plan was announced at Token2049 in Singapore.

events.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for 82m US Galaxy devices
events.summary: From late October, eligible US Galaxy users can send USDC from Samsung Wallet, with Bastion as regulated custodian and Coinbase Prime as sub-custodian. Recipients without wallets can be paid in local currency in 60+ countries.

events.title: London's Noah adds $16m, taking stablecoin payments seed to $38m
events.summary: Noah, which links stablecoin settlement to local payment rails, raised a further $16m from Endeit, FJ Labs, LocalGlobe and Felix Capital, lifting its seed round to $38m. The money funds a New York office and a US push.

round.use_of_funds: US expansion, including a New York office

events.title: Circle and SAP-backed Tereina to bring USDC and EURC to SAP Pay
events.summary: Circle and Tereina, a company backed by SAP, plan to build USDC and EURC into Tereina's payment stack, beginning with SAP Cloud ERP through SAP Pay. Proof-of-value pilots come first; no wider rollout date was set.

events.title: Dubai-based Kora adds stablecoin payments for African businesses
events.summary: Kora, a Dubai-headquartered payments provider serving African markets, added USDT and USDC to its platform: merchants can receive, hold, exchange and settle stablecoins alongside fiat and pay out to local bank accounts through its existing network.

events.title: Paxos issues USDG natively on Arbitrum with DAO liquidity support
events.summary: Paxos's Global Dollar (USDG), at roughly $3.1bn in circulation, went live natively on Arbitrum One. Arbitrum joined the Global Dollar Network, and a DAO proposal would add 100m ARB in incentives for USDG.

events.title: Spiko raises $90m Series B led by NEA for tokenised cash funds
events.summary: Spiko, a Paris and London issuer of tokenised cash funds holding $2.7bn, raised a $90m Series B led by NEA with Index Ventures, Bpifrance, Speedinvest, Flourish Ventures, Shapers and White Star Capital.

round.use_of_funds: growing its tokenised cash funds

events.title: OKX launches OKX Money for stablecoin saving and spending
events.summary: OKX launched OKX Money, letting eligible customers convert over 50 local currencies into dollar stablecoins and spend them with a virtual or physical card.

events.title: zerohash becomes a Tempo validator and infrastructure partner
events.summary: zerohash joined the validator set of Stripe-backed Tempo and became an infrastructure partner, giving its bank, fintech and brokerage clients access to Tempo stablecoin rails for payouts, payroll and merchant settlement.

events.title: Brale issues Verona's verUSD stablecoin for AI-agent payments
events.summary: Verona launched verUSD, a dollar-backed token for payments by AI agents, issued by Brale on Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and other chains, with reserves at regulated US institutions. Verona cited $100m of launch commitments.

events.title: Ant International pilots HSBC tokenised deposits in the UAE
events.summary: Ant International ran pilot payments on HSBC's Tokenised Deposit Service via its WhaleRTP treasury platform, covering dirham transfers inside the UAE and dollar flows to Hong Kong and Singapore. It is HSBC's first such client in the region.

events.title: Anchorage Digital buys B2B payouts platform Routable
events.summary: Anchorage Digital acquired accounts-payable payouts firm Routable for an undisclosed sum. It will run as Routable by Anchorage Digital and add stablecoin and tokenised-deposit settlement to corporate payout flows in coming quarters.

deal.rationale: stablecoin and tokenised-deposit settlement for corporate payouts

events.title: VARA sets tougher standards for audits of VASP reserves
events.summary: After reviewing 2025 proof-of-reserve reports, VARA told auditors to confirm that client holdings were backed 1:1 throughout the period, check wallet segregation and flag any lending or pledging of client assets.

events.title: ADGM FSRA consults on DeFi risk management guidance
events.summary: Consultation Paper 5 of 2026 sets out how firms the FSRA authorises should manage risks from DeFi protocols and venues, including governance, due diligence and safeguarding client assets. Comments are due by 30 Nov 2026.

events.title: Stripe plans stablecoin cards in over 100 countries by year end
events.summary: Stripe plans to expand its stablecoin cards to more than 100 countries by the end of the year and is exploring tokenised deposits, with Privy's Henri Stern now overseeing crypto across Stripe.

events.title: Kraken's parent taps Singapore Gulf Bank for 24/7 dollar settlement
events.summary: Payward integrated SGB Net, the real-time clearing network of Bahrain-licensed Singapore Gulf Bank, so institutions in Asia and the Gulf can settle in US dollars around the clock.

events.title: Eleven firms form Eurøpe Consortium to push Schuman's EURØP
events.summary: eToro, SwissBorg, Coinhouse, DFNS, LCX, RockawayX and others set up a group to widen distribution and use of EURØP, the MiCA euro token from ACPR-authorised Schuman. Joining does not oblige members to list or integrate it.

events.title: US stablecoin card firm Rain seeks OCC trust bank charter
events.summary: Rain, the US stablecoin card issuer (unrelated to Bahrain's Rain), applied to the OCC for an uninsured New York trust bank to custody digital assets and dollars, manage issuer reserves and issue and redeem dollar stablecoins.

events.title: Modern Treasury applies to the OCC for a national trust bank
events.summary: Modern Treasury asked the OCC to charter Modern Treasury National Trust Bank, a limited-purpose bank for federally supervised digital asset custody and related fiat services. It would neither lend nor issue stablecoins.

events.title: FinCEN withdraws unhosted-wallet and crypto-mixer proposals
events.summary: FinCEN pulled its 2020 plan to make banks and money services businesses verify and record transfers with self-hosted wallets, along with its 2023 mixer finding and rule. Neither had been finalised, so current duties stay the same.

events.title: DIMOCO lets merchants take settlement in euro and dollar stablecoins
events.summary: Austrian payment institution DIMOCO now offers merchants payout in EUR and USD stablecoins to a digital wallet, including outside banking hours, using infrastructure from French MiCA CASP Fipto. Checkout is unchanged for shoppers.

events.title: VARA and UAE Financial Intelligence Unit sign crypto-crime MoU
events.summary: The two bodies agreed to share financial intelligence and expertise to fight crime involving virtual assets. The deal is an inter-agency arrangement and adds no new rules for licensed firms.

events.title: Rain MENA FZE receives full VARA licence for exchange and brokerage
events.summary: VARA's register lists an active VASP licence for Rain MENA FZE dated 5 Oct 2026, covering exchange and broker-dealer services for retail as well as institutional clients. Margin trading, part of the earlier approval, is not listed.

events.title: UAE and Moroccan central banks sign MoUs touching stablecoin rules
events.summary: The CBUAE and Bank Al-Maghrib signed two memoranda in Abu Dhabi to study linking instant payment systems and card switches, share CBDC know-how for cross-border use and cooperate on crypto-asset and stablecoin regulation.

events.title: Community bankers sue the OCC over crypto trust charters
events.summary: The ICBA sued the OCC in federal court in Washington, arguing it went beyond its powers by chartering trust banks that do no fiduciary work. The OCC has approved at least 13 crypto firms for trust charters.

events.title: Fiserv's digital asset platform goes live with Roughrider Coin
events.summary: Fiserv's digital asset platform went live for banks, with Bank of North Dakota's Roughrider Coin the first stablecoin on it, issued by VersaBank with Fireblocks providing tokenisation.

events.title: Open USD goes live on four chains, issued by Bridge
events.summary: Open USD, the stablecoin of Open Standard, founded by Coinbase, Mastercard, Shopify, Stripe and Visa, went live on Base, Ethereum, Solana and Tempo, issued by Stripe's Bridge.

events.title: Treasury sets process for certifying state stablecoin regimes
events.summary: Treasury issued an interim final rule, effective at once, setting forms, cure and appeal steps for the committee that certifies state stablecoin regimes, ahead of the January 2028 deadline.

events.title: AllUnity launches USDAU, a MiCA-compliant dollar stablecoin
events.summary: AllUnity released its fourth token, USDAU, on six chains including Ethereum, Solana, Base and Tempo, giving EU firms dollar liquidity within MiCA. Banking Circle holds the reserves and provides transaction banking.

events.title: ESMA urges explicit MiCA curbs on non-compliant stablecoins
events.summary: In its response to the European Commission's MiCA review, ESMA asked for explicit rules barring regulated crypto firms from serving stablecoins that do not meet MiCA, and for stronger powers over non-EU firms soliciting EU clients.

events.title: Jeeves raises $110m led by CoinFund for stablecoin wallets
events.summary: Miami-based corporate payments firm Jeeves closed a $110m Series C led by CoinFund with a16z, Coinbase Ventures and AllianceBernstein, to launch stablecoin wallets and instant payouts across 35 countries.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin wallets, AI automation and instant payouts

events.title: Citi and Coinbase widen tie-up on corporate stablecoin payments
events.summary: Coinbase will use Citi's virtual account wallet to convert fiat to stablecoins automatically, while Citi clients can accept stablecoin payments with Coinbase handling the rails and conversion, starting in the US.

events.title: Shiga unveils USDT wallet products for Africa and Gulf on Tether kit
events.summary: Tether-backed Shiga unveiled ENTA for consumers and businesses and Pulse for banks and fintechs, built on Tether's Wallet Development Kit, offering self-custodial USDT, bitcoin and XAUT wallets and corridor settlement in Africa and the GCC.

events.title: Monerium and Bermuda launch private on-chain bank payments
events.summary: Monerium mints EURe from the sender's bank account and redeems into the recipient's SEPA account, while Bermuda routes payments through shielded accounts with zero-knowledge compliance proofs, aimed at corporate flows into Europe.

events.title: UK banks complete first interbank payments with tokenised sterling
events.summary: Barclays, NatWest, HSBC and other UK banks completed interbank customer transactions with tokenised sterling deposits, including remortgage payments and a marketplace purchase.

events.title: HIFI raises $37m Series A led by Left Lane Capital
events.summary: Stablecoin infrastructure firm HIFI raised a $37m Series A, its first priced round, led by Left Lane Capital, to expand its stablecoin payments and tokenised capital markets services.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin payments and tokenised capital markets

events.title: The Clearing House picks Quant for tokenised deposit interoperability
events.summary: The Clearing House selected Quant to build interoperability for interbank payments with tokenised deposits, targeting a launch in the first half of 2027.

events.title: Federal Reserve proposes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: The Fed issued two proposals: reserve, capital and risk rules for stablecoin issuers it supervises, and an application and appeal process for state member banks that want to issue. Comments run for 60 days.

events.title: MoonPay agrees to acquire broker-dealer group North Capital
events.summary: MoonPay signed a merger agreement for North Capital, which runs SEC-registered broker-dealers and the PPEX alternative trading system, to expand into tokenised securities. Terms were not disclosed and approvals are pending.

deal.rationale: move into tokenised securities

events.title: Canada's six largest banks plan a shared tokenised deposit network
events.summary: Canada's Big Six banks plan an interbank tokenised deposit initiative, starting with moving digital commercial deposits between them before linking to wider digital asset markets.

events.title: Atum emerges with $13.5m to build an open payments network
events.summary: San Francisco-based Atum came out of stealth with a $13.5m seed led by Variant and PayPal Ventures to coordinate global money movement across currencies, blockchains and payment rails without holding funds.

round.use_of_funds: its Open Payments Network

events.title: Binance buys $100m of Circle shares and renews USDC deal
events.summary: Binance agreed to buy $100m of Circle Class A shares in a private placement and hold them for up to two years. The pair also signed a new five-year agreement to grow USDC use, chiefly in emerging markets.

events.title: Report: Saudi central bank has left the mBridge CBDC platform
events.summary: The FT reported that SAMA has left mBridge, the shared-ledger cross-border CBDC platform. It joined in June 2024 and stopped taking part after a proof of concept in May 2025, and says the exit was planned.

events.title: OCC conditionally approves Bastion, Agora and Catena trust banks
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved three digital-asset national trust banks: a conversion of Bastion's New York trust and new charters for Agora and Catena Labs. Agora plans to move AUSD issuance into its bank.

events.title: CBUAE says five dirham stablecoin projects are in progress
events.summary: The CBUAE's chief fintech officer said four bank-linked and one non-bank AED stablecoin projects are progressing, and that a consultation on improving the payment token rules is coming soon.

events.title: FCA sets 30 September opening for crypto and stablecoin authorisation
events.summary: The FCA published perimeter guidance for the UK crypto regime, covering stablecoin issuance, trading, dealing, safeguarding and staking; its authorisation gateway opens on 30 September 2026 and the regime on 25 October 2027.

events.title: Deutsche Bank nears crypto custody launch including USDC and EURC
events.summary: Deutsche Bank plans to launch digital asset custody for European institutional and corporate clients, supporting bitcoin, ether and stablecoins such as USDC and EURC.

events.title: Column adds its own card processor, including stablecoin-backed cards
events.summary: Column, the developer-focused US bank, built its own issuer processor so clients can run card programmes, including stablecoin-backed cards, on Visa and Mastercard through one integration.

events.title: Circle opens Arc mainnet with BlackRock and Visa among validators
events.summary: Circle launched the public mainnet of Arc, its layer-1 chain with fees paid in USDC, with founding validators including BlackRock, Visa and Mastercard. It minted 10bn ARC tokens without committing to a public token launch.

events.title: Fasset says it will be first VARA-regulated venue to list DDSC
events.summary: Fasset said it will list the DDSC dirham stablecoin once VARA approves the token, using the CBUAE no-objection certificate that lets DDSC be distributed on selected VARA-regulated platforms.

events.title: Visa, Circle and Ripple back Velocity at a $200m valuation
events.summary: Velocity added $10m from Visa Ventures, Circle Ventures, Haun Ventures, Ripple, Translink Capital and Mirana Ventures, taking its Series A to $48m at a $200m post-money valuation.

round.use_of_funds: moving settlement and treasury onto stablecoin rails

events.title: CLARITY Act fails to clear the Senate's 60-vote hurdle
events.summary: The crypto market structure bill could not win enough votes to advance in the Senate, leaving firms to rely on agency rules that a future administration could reverse.

events.title: Nasdaq invests $100m in Kraken's parent Payward
events.summary: Nasdaq is investing $100m in Payward, deepening a tokenised equities partnership announced in March, with Nasdaq Equity Tokens now targeted for the second quarter of 2027.

round.use_of_funds: a strategic stake alongside a tokenised equities partnership

events.title: MoneyGram launches a stablecoin-backed card with Rain
events.summary: MoneyGram launched the MoneyGram Card, a stablecoin-backed card for eligible customers worldwide built with Rain, reaching a base of over 60 million active customers.

events.title: U.S. Bank runs a live USBDC stablecoin pilot on Stellar
events.summary: U.S. Bank completed a live cross-border pilot of USBDC, its own dollar stablecoin, between its North American and European entities on the public Stellar network, with mint, redeem, freeze and clawback.

events.title: Modern Treasury launches non-custodial stablecoin wallets
events.summary: Modern Treasury launched non-custodial wallets for USDG, USDC and USDT in more than 90 countries, joined to its global USD accounts and payment orchestration through one API.

events.title: Flex uses Mesh for crypto and stablecoin deposits by business owners
events.summary: Finance platform Flex partnered with Mesh so business owners can fund their accounts directly from hundreds of exchanges and wallets in crypto and stablecoins.

events.title: Texas-based Latitude raises $35m Series A for stablecoin payouts
events.summary: Latitude, founded by Stripe, Uber, Coinbase and Meta alumni, raised a $35m Series A to let businesses use stablecoins to send local currency to bank accounts and mobile wallets.

round.use_of_funds: local payouts funded by stablecoins

events.title: Marqeta turns to BVNK for stablecoin-backed cards
events.summary: Card issuing platform Marqeta partnered with BVNK to offer stablecoin-backed card programmes to crypto and non-crypto companies.

events.title: Block applies for a bank charter for Builders Bank
events.summary: Block applied for a charter for Builders Bank, a branchless bank in Sioux Falls that would consolidate the custody it now runs under more than 50 state licences, after $10.7bn of bitcoin volume in 2025.

events.title: Network International pilots in-store DDSC payments
events.summary: Shoppers with DDSC wallets can pay by scanning a QR code on Network's POS terminals at Marks & Spencer in Dubai Festival City and LuLu in Abu Dhabi. Merchants can settle in DDSC or dirhams.

events.title: Circle agrees to buy Singapore cross-border payments firm Tazapay
events.summary: Circle signed a definitive agreement to acquire Tazapay, a Singapore B2B cross-border payments platform. Completion is expected in 2027, subject to conditions including approval by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

deal.rationale: expand cross-border payments infrastructure

events.title: MoonPay Europe wins Dutch e-money licence covering stablecoins
events.summary: DNB granted MoonPay Europe an e-money licence for payment accounts and stablecoin issuance. Combined with its AFM MiCA CASP status, it can now issue euro stablecoins across the EEA.

events.title: Fuze expands to Switzerland after joining an AML self-regulator
events.summary: Fuze's Swiss entity was admitted to SO-FIT, a FINMA-authorised self-regulatory body, so it can offer institutional brokerage, OTC trading and stablecoin settlement alongside SWIFT, SEPA and SIC.

events.title: Copper CEO to depart as sale bids reportedly near $200M
events.summary: CoinDesk reports CEO Amar Kuchinad is leaving custody and settlement firm Copper, whose sale has been marketed by Cantor Fitzgerald at $500M since at least May while offers have reportedly come in around $200M.

deal.rationale: sale process run by Cantor Fitzgerald

events.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to its Dubai FX platform
events.summary: Standard Chartered let institutional clients trade bitcoin and ether on its foreign-exchange platforms from Dubai and settle with a custodian of their choice, including its own.

events.title: Kraken joins SoFi's settlement network and lists SoFiUSD
events.summary: SoFi and Kraken linked up: Kraken joins SoFi's banking and dollar settlement rails and lists SoFiUSD, while SoFi brings Kraken's trading infrastructure to its customers.

events.title: OpenPayd folds in MSB USA and its 43 state money transmitter licences
events.summary: OpenPayd's founder is merging Texas-based MSB USA into the company, adding 43 US state money transmitter licences and US payment routing ahead of the planned Nasdaq listing.

deal.rationale: US state licences and payment routing before its listing

events.title: KAST launches a stablecoin business platform for 170+ countries
events.summary: KAST launched KAST Business, giving companies in over 170 countries stablecoin-based accounts, cards, cross-border payments and contractor payroll, with fiat virtual accounts from regulated partners beside on-chain assets.

events.title: Félix raises $200m in equity and debt for stablecoin remittances
events.summary: Miami-based Félix, which sends remittances to Latin America over WhatsApp using stablecoins, raised $200m: an $87m equity round led by a16z and a $113m credit facility from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund.

round.use_of_funds: remittances, lending and savings products

events.title: Bank-backed Cari raises $32.5m for a tokenised deposit network
events.summary: Cari, a bank-governed network for tokenised deposits, raised $32.5m in a first tranche backed entirely by banks, including First Horizon, Huntington, KeyBank, M&T, Old National, SouthState and Glacier Bank.

round.use_of_funds: a shared network for regional and community banks to bring money on-chain

events.title: Goldman, BofA, Citi and 18 others plan a joint dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Twenty-one banks and asset managers, including Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi, Deutsche Bank, UBS, Santander and MUFG, will form a company to issue a dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

events.title: Utila connects unlicensed fintechs to regulated stablecoin partners
events.summary: Utila lets fintechs without their own licences launch stablecoin payment and custody products through regulated partners via one integration, starting with France's Fipto (MiCA CASP), CoinGate and North American custodians.

events.title: Coinbax lets banks and credit unions take stablecoin deposits
events.summary: Coinbax launched Coinbax Deposits, which lets banks and credit unions accept stablecoin deposits as dollars on their own balance sheets; it also screens, holds and releases payments across FedNow, RTP, wires and stablecoins.

events.title: UK plans a new Bank of England objective for stablecoins
events.summary: The UK plans to give the Bank of England a new objective covering stablecoins, with financial stability still its first duty and annual reports to Parliament, alongside a temporary £40bn cap per systemic token.

events.title: OpenPayd connects to Circle Payments Network
events.summary: OpenPayd joined Circle Payments Network so clients can send cross-border fiat payments that settle in USDC or EURC within seconds, starting with euro to real and sterling to peso corridors.

events.title: Revolut rolls out euro stablecoin EURR issued by Bridge
events.summary: Revolut began a phased rollout of EURR to customers in Denmark, Poland and Portugal. The euro token is issued by Bridge's CSSF-licensed Luxembourg entity, which manages the reserves; wider EEA availability is planned this year.

events.title: zerohash reapplies to the OCC for a narrower trust charter
events.summary: zerohash filed a new application for an OCC national trust bank charter, which it said would be narrower, after the regulator handed back its first application.

events.title: US state banking associations plan the BankChain Alliance network
events.summary: US state banking associations plan a nationwide blockchain network, the BankChain Alliance, aimed at a 2027 launch for stablecoins, payments and tokenised deposits within bank regulation.

events.title: Zand to support Circle's USDC alongside its dirham stablecoin
events.summary: Zand plans to add USDC so eligible businesses can use it together with Zand's AED stablecoin for payments, settlement, treasury and cross-border flows, subject to regulatory and market conditions.

events.title: Standard Chartered distributes Anchorpoint's HKDAP stablecoin
events.summary: Standard Chartered became the first bank to distribute HKDAP, the Hong Kong dollar stablecoin issued by its Anchorpoint venture, to eligible clients and partners.

events.title: Fasset hits $1bn valuation with $68m Series C led by SBI
events.summary: Japan's SBI Group led a $68m round valuing Fasset at $1bn, taking its 2026 total to $119m. Funds go to its corridor banking network and AI tools for stablecoin settlement and tokenised assets.

round.use_of_funds: its Own Network of banking corridors and AI tools for stablecoin settlement

events.title: HSBC and StanChart settle the first live payment on Swift's ledger
events.summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered completed the first live interbank transaction on Swift's blockchain ledger, using tokenised deposits for real-time cross-border settlement in a 17-bank pilot.

events.title: Ripple Prime raises $275m in investment-grade senior notes
events.summary: Ripple raised $275m in an upsized private placement of senior unsecured notes through Ripple Prime, rated BBB by KBRA, for working capital and expansion of its prime brokerage.

round.use_of_funds: working capital and prime brokerage expansion

events.title: Natural raises up to $100m credit facility for AI agent payments
events.summary: Natural, which builds payments for AI agents, raised a credit facility of up to $100m from Upper90 on top of $40m of equity.

round.use_of_funds: scaling payments for AI agents

events.title: FASB proposes treating qualifying stablecoins as cash equivalents
events.summary: The Financial Accounting Standards Board proposed that certain stablecoins count as cash equivalents under US GAAP, alongside Treasuries, commercial paper and money market funds.

events.title: OCC conditionally approves World Liberty Trust's national charter
events.summary: The OCC granted preliminary conditional approval for World Liberty Financial to set up a national trust bank that would issue its USD1 stablecoin.

events.title: Treasury proposes GENIUS Act rules on who may issue stablecoins
events.summary: The Treasury proposed rules making issuance without a federal or state licence unlawful unless a foreign issuer is from a comparable regime and registered with the OCC, with a due-diligence duty on exchanges.

events.title: Stripe reported to agree an $8bn-plus deal for AI router OpenRouter
events.summary: Stripe reportedly agreed to buy OpenRouter, a marketplace that routes and bills AI model inference, for more than $8bn, a bet on agent payments; OpenRouter was valued at $1.3bn in May.

deal.rationale: payments for AI agents and inference markets

events.title: Austria's FMA fines Bitpanda in its first published MiCA case
events.summary: Austria's Financial Market Authority fined Bitpanda €70,000 for filing a white paper late and omitting required disclosures in marketing, its first penalty under MiCA.

events.title: BitGo Europe gets direct mint access to AllUnity stablecoins
events.summary: BitGo Europe, the BaFin-registered CASP of NYSE-listed BitGo, can now mint and redeem AllUnity's MiCA-compliant EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU directly, giving its clients on-demand liquidity for settlement, treasury and trading.

events.title: Crossmint registers in Canada under the RPAA and with FINTRAC
events.summary: Crossmint registered with the Bank of Canada as a payment service provider under the RPAA and with FINTRAC as a money services business, opening on- and off-ramps and transfers for Canadian clients.

events.title: Rain buys stored-value platform Ansa
events.summary: Rain acquired Ansa, whose branded stored-value and closed-loop payments technology runs over Mastercard rails, so partners can offer branded apps with balances, rewards and a card.

deal.rationale: branded stored-value wallets

events.title: Coinbase wins approval to run tokenised securities from Abu Dhabi
events.summary: Coinbase said it secured regulatory approval to offer tokenised securities from Abu Dhabi, making the emirate the base for its international tokenisation business.

events.title: Visa Direct adds stablecoin prefunding and payouts through zerohash
events.summary: zerohash and Visa brought stablecoin prefunding and payouts to eligible Visa Direct clients, a network reaching over 18 billion endpoints in more than 195 countries.

events.title: Tether brings its Hadron tokenisation platform to Saudi Arabia
events.summary: Tether is extending its Hadron tokenisation platform into Saudi Arabia, starting with institutional real estate, with Saudi partners First Data and fintech BKN301.

events.title: MoonPay launches Enterprise suite for stablecoin payments
events.summary: Built on the Iron platform it acquired, MoonPay Enterprise offers virtual accounts, multi-currency treasury, fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and cross-border payouts through a single API.

events.title: Lightspark launches a Visa card programme settling in USDC with Lithic
events.summary: Lithic and Lightspark partnered on Lightspark's Visa card programme, issued by Lead Bank and settling in USDC.

events.title: Ripple and OpenFX invest in Schuman in euro-rails tie-up
events.summary: Ripple, OpenFX and others made an undisclosed investment in Schuman as part of a deal giving them access to euro rails, with EURØP added to the XRPL permissioned DEX for on-chain FX.

round.use_of_funds: EURØP adoption, institutional integrations and infrastructure

events.title: Wells Fargo to launch tokenised deposits for corporate clients
events.summary: Wells Fargo will launch tokenised deposits on its own blockchain this autumn, starting with a dollar-to-pound exchange for selected corporate clients, with the same protections as its other deposits.

events.title: Cloudflare launches Wallets for AI agent payments
events.summary: Cloudflare announced Cloudflare Wallets, giving AI agents native payments and verifiable identity on the web through the x402 protocol, with spending limits and stablecoin self-funding.

events.title: Deutsche Telekom joins SphereNet as a validator
events.summary: Deutsche Telekom joined SphereNet, Sphere Labs' compliance-focused ledger for regulated payments, as a validator partner ahead of its public launch.

events.title: Mastercard closes its up-to-$1.8B purchase of BVNK
events.summary: Mastercard closed its purchase of UK-based stablecoin infrastructure firm BVNK after regulatory approvals were met. Agreed in March, the deal is worth up to $1.8B: $1.5B upfront and up to $300M in performance-linked payments.

deal.rationale: connect on-chain payments with fiat rails

events.title: Brale tests ION, a protocol to move custom stablecoins across chains
events.summary: Brale debuted ION on testnet, a protocol to move custom stablecoins between blockchains without prefunded liquidity pools, as hundreds of companies issue their own tokens.

events.title: Emirates lets UAE residents pay for flights with Crypto.com Pay
events.summary: Eligible UAE residents can now pay for Emirates bookings with Crypto.com Pay, with fares priced and settled in dirhams. Crypto.com holds a CBUAE stored value facilities licence.

events.title: Kraken's parent agrees to buy Magic Labs' embedded wallet business
events.summary: Payward signed a deal to acquire Magic Labs' wallet-as-a-service unit, which has supported over 60 million wallets and $10bn in stablecoin volume, for its business infrastructure platform.

deal.rationale: embedded non-custodial wallets for business clients

events.title: Wise to reapply for a US trust charter under the GENIUS Act
events.summary: Wise plans a new national trust bank application built around the GENIUS Act after the OCC denied its first one over anti-money laundering concerns.

events.title: Ripple invests in compliance network Notabene and adds RLUSD
events.summary: Ripple made a strategic investment in Notabene, whose network of 2,300+ institutions handles regulated on-chain transfers worth over $2tn a year; RLUSD will be built into Notabene Flow for enterprise stablecoin payments.

round.use_of_funds: compliant enterprise stablecoin payments

events.title: Augustus raises $180m at a $1bn valuation led by Tiger Global
events.summary: Augustus, building a federally chartered clearing bank that joins traditional payment systems and stablecoins for fintechs and banks, raised $180m at a $1bn valuation led by Tiger Global with Hummingbird, QED and founders of Nubank, Ramp, Circle and Deel.

round.use_of_funds: dollar payment infrastructure

events.title: Visa launches a platform for banks to mint and manage stablecoins
events.summary: Visa launched the Visa Stablecoin Platform so banks and fintechs can mint, move and manage stablecoins through its network, reaching more than 200 million merchants.

events.title: Cyclops raises $20m to speed up payment settlement with stablecoins
events.summary: Miami-based Cyclops, whose clients include Mastercard, raised a $20m Series A led by Nava Ventures with Castle Island Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Circle, Lasagna and GPT Ventures to help payment firms settle faster with stablecoins.

round.use_of_funds: faster settlement for payment providers

events.title: TD to custody reserves behind Stablecorp's QCAD
events.summary: TD Bank Group will hold the fiat reserves backing QCAD Digital Trust, phased in over the second half of 2026, one of the first cases of a major Canadian bank acting as a stablecoin reserve custodian.

events.title: Stripe and Advent make a $53bn approach for PayPal
events.summary: Stripe and Advent International offered roughly $53bn, or $60.50 a share, for PayPal with about $50bn of committed financing. PayPal's board was reported to see the offer as too low, and the bidders later walked away.

deal.rationale: takeover approach judged too low

events.title: London's Velocity raises $38m Series A led by Dragonfly and FirstMark
events.summary: London-based Velocity, which helps businesses build stablecoins into payments, settlement and treasury, raised a $38m Series A co-led by Dragonfly and FirstMark with Coinbase, Capital One Ventures, QED, Activant, Ripple and Wintermute.

events.title: US and UK agree a roadmap to align tokenised finance rules
events.summary: The United States and the United Kingdom set out a joint roadmap to explore common rules for tokenised securities, cross-border stablecoin activity and industry tokenisation pilots.

events.title: Tether leads $7m Series A in Pact Labs for USAT payroll
events.summary: Tether led a $7m Series A in Pact Labs, with Blockchange Ventures and Lasagna, to build USAT, its US-regulated dollar token, into payroll, earned wage access, credit and everyday payments for American workers.

round.use_of_funds: USAT across payroll, earned wage access, credit and payments

events.title: Circle wins final OCC approval for its national trust bank
events.summary: The OCC gave final approval for Circle's national trust bank, to operate as Circle National Trust. It will start with digital asset custody for Circle and could later manage USDC reserves.

events.title: Sony Bank wins conditional OCC approval for a US stablecoin bank
events.summary: Sony Bank received conditional OCC approval to set up Connectia Trust, a US national trust bank for its stablecoin business.

events.title: Infinia raises $13.5m Series A to link bank rails with stablecoins
events.summary: New York-based Infinia, an infrastructure layer connecting traditional banking with digital asset rails, raised a $13.5m Series A led by Bain Capital and Variant with Y Combinator, Lattice and others.

round.use_of_funds: regional licences and expansion

events.title: European Parliament backs stablecoin multi-issuance
events.summary: The European Parliament adopted a report on digital assets by 390 votes to 86 that supports multi-issuance, rejecting a proposed ban on stablecoins issued both inside and outside the EU.

events.title: EU set to reopen MiCA in 2027 to cover foreign stablecoin issuers
events.summary: The EU is preparing to reopen MiCA, likely in 2027, to regulate non-EU stablecoin issuers and widen its scope, EU diplomats told Euronews, citing pressure from the GENIUS Act and dollar stablecoins.

events.title: Siam Commercial Bank goes live on Citi's tokenised deposit clearing
events.summary: Thailand's Siam Commercial Bank became the first respondent bank live on Citi's 24/7 service that combines its tokenised deposits with its clearing network for round-the-clock US dollar payments.

events.title: Latvia licenses Nodu under MiCA and as a payment institution
events.summary: Latvijas Banka licensed Nodu Digital SIA for crypto-asset services (exchange for funds and transfers for clients) and as a payment institution, its tenth MiCA licence; the authorisation can be passported across the EU.

events.title: Kraken seeks a European banking licence in Lithuania
events.summary: Kraken is pursuing a European banking licence with Lithuania as the target jurisdiction, following the path of Revolut, a person familiar with the plans told CoinDesk.

events.title: Delaware enacts a GENIUS-style law for state stablecoin issuers
events.summary: Delaware's governor signed SB 19, the Delaware Payment Stablecoins Act, with two banking bills: issuers must redeem within two business days, publish monthly reserve reports and, if new, hold at least $5m of capital.

events.title: Ripple's MiCA CASP approval made final, opening all 30 EEA markets
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF upgraded Ripple's June preliminary approval to full MiCA crypto-asset service provider authorisation, so Ripple can sell its regulated crypto payments product to institutions and businesses in all 30 EEA countries.

events.title: CBUAE clears DDSC for listing on VARA-regulated exchanges
events.summary: A central bank no-objection certificate lets DDSC go live on selected VARA-regulated platforms, opening it to retail buying, redemption and dirham payments. Over AED 150m had been transacted in DDSC by then.

events.title: Standard Chartered offers USDC minting and redemption from the DIFC
events.summary: Standard Chartered and Circle launched bank-led USDC minting and redemption for institutional clients, starting with the bank's DIFC operations, for uses such as on-chain settlement and treasury.

events.title: Stripe's Bridge wins MiCA CASP and EMI licences in Luxembourg
events.summary: The CSSF authorised Bridge Building S.A. as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider and e-money institution, so Bridge can offer euro accounts with named IBANs and help businesses issue their own euro stablecoins across the EU.

events.title: Circle Ventures invests in Flutterwave as it adds USDC settlement
events.summary: Flutterwave announced a strategic investment from Circle Ventures and added USDC settlement across its platform, alongside RLUSD through its Ripple partnership; it has processed over $50bn across Africa.

round.use_of_funds: USDC settlement across its platform

events.title: Crédit Agricole launches the EURXT euro stablecoin
events.summary: Crédit Agricole rolled out EURXT, a euro stablecoin backed 1:1 by reserves at CACEIS Bank, launching with about 20m tokens on Ethereum and competing with Circle's EURC and SocGen's EURCV.

events.title: MiCA grace period ends with USDT still unauthorised in the EU
events.summary: MiCA's transitional period for crypto firms ended on 1 July 2026 with Tether still not seeking EU authorisation for USDT, which The Paypers reports is gone from regulated EU exchanges; Tether objects to rules forcing large EU bank deposit reserves.

events.title: UBS tests cross-border stablecoin payments with Merge
events.summary: UBS ran a proof of concept with Merge and corporate clients, sending stablecoin payments from Switzerland to several countries in under two minutes; it has not announced a production launch.

events.title: Over 140 firms back Open USD, a stablecoin with shared reserve income
events.summary: A coalition of more than 140 companies including BlackRock, Coinbase, Mastercard, Stripe and Visa joined Open USD, run by the independent Open Standard, which returns most reserve income to partners.

events.title: FCA cuts stablecoin issuer capital requirement to 1%
events.summary: The FCA set out its formal crypto guidance and cut the capital requirement for stablecoin issuers to 1% of tokens in circulation, from a proposed 2%, below the EU's MiCA requirements.

events.title: MetaMask launches Money Account for stablecoin yield and spending
events.summary: MetaMask launched Money Account, letting users earn up to 4% variable yield on stablecoins, spend them with the MetaMask Card and trade from one account.

events.title: BNY adds stablecoin minting, burning and custody, starting with USDC
events.summary: BNY launched stablecoin mint, burn and custody for institutional clients, with Circle's USDC the first stablecoin on its digital asset custody platform.

events.title: Euroclear and Société Générale test a dollar stablecoin for settlement
events.summary: Euroclear and Société Générale are testing a US dollar stablecoin to settle tokenised commercial paper in European markets.

events.title: Binance suspends EU services after withdrawing its MiCA application
events.summary: A day after withdrawing its MiCA licence application in Greece, Binance told users across the EU it would suspend some services, having failed to secure authorisation before the transition period ended.

events.title: MoonPay buys Entendre, maker of AI agents for finance teams
events.summary: MoonPay acquired Entendre, whose AI agents automate reconciliation, treasury and month-end close for customers such as Polygon Labs and Brale, extending its stablecoin payments stack into finance operations.

deal.rationale: AI agents for reconciliation, treasury and close

events.title: Bank of England drops stablecoin holding limits for a £40bn cap
events.summary: The Bank of England scrapped planned caps on individual and corporate stablecoin holdings in favour of a £40bn aggregate issuance limit and better yield terms for issuers, ahead of a 2027 launch.

events.title: Zug's Range raises $8.3m Series A for stablecoin compliance
events.summary: Range, a Zug-based platform for stablecoin and fiat compliance and treasury, raised an $8.3m Series A backed by TX Ventures, SixThirty, Maven 11 and Onigiri Capital, taking its total to $11m.

round.use_of_funds: its compliance and treasury platform

events.title: Anchorage launches a tokenised deposit platform for banks
events.summary: Anchorage Digital launched a platform that lets banks offer 24/7 payments and settlement with tokenised deposits, while the funds stay in their existing deposit accounts.

events.title: US agencies propose customer ID rules for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: The Federal Reserve, Treasury, OCC and FDIC proposed a GENIUS Act rule setting bank-style customer identification standards for stablecoin issuers, now open for comment.

events.title: Avalanche launches a Payments Collective of 28 firms
events.summary: Avalanche launched the Avalanche Payments Collective, bringing together 28 firms across settlement, stablecoin issuance, FX and merchant acceptance, including Franklin Templeton, VanEck, Fireblocks and Galaxy.

events.title: Ripple invests in Flutterwave's Series E at a $3.2bn valuation
events.summary: Ripple invested in African payments firm Flutterwave's Series E, which values Flutterwave at $3.2bn, in a deal to bring RLUSD and the XRP Ledger into its cross-border payments. Ripple's stake was not disclosed.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin cross-border payments across Africa

events.title: Digital Asset raises $355m led by a16z crypto at a $2bn valuation
events.summary: Digital Asset, developer of the Canton Network, raised $355m led by a16z crypto at a $2bn valuation to bring capital markets on-chain.

round.use_of_funds: growing the Canton Network for capital markets

events.title: Orbital plans Miami-led US entry for stablecoin payments
events.summary: Orbital set out a phased US launch from Miami aimed at PSPs, remittance and crypto firms, and plans to seek state money transmission licences over the next 12 to 18 months.

events.title: New York proposes stablecoin rules built on the federal rulebook
events.summary: NYDFS proposed new rules for dollar stablecoins that align its regime with the OCC's federal proposals, with a few tougher requirements, aiming to keep issuers chartered in New York.

events.title: Banking Circle gives Bridge local euro and sterling payment rails
events.summary: Banking Circle is supplying Stripe's Bridge with multi-currency accounts, local clearing access and SWIFT dollar transfers, helping Bridge clients convert between stablecoins and local currencies such as euros and sterling.

events.title: Coinbase and Cardless launch a stablecoin-secured credit card
events.summary: Coinbase and Cardless unveiled a credit card secured by stablecoins for customers who would not be approved for an unsecured card, extending their Coinbase-branded card partnership.

events.title: Zodia Custody gains CSSF payment licence for EU stablecoin custody
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF granted Zodia Custody a payment institution licence on top of its MiCA authorisation, allowing it to offer regulated custody and transfers of e-money tokens (stablecoins) across the EU.

events.title: Nine Italian banks join Bancomat's EUR.bank stablecoin
events.summary: Bancomat named the nine founding banks for EUR.bank, its planned euro stablecoin, including Banca Generali, Banca Sella, BPER and Intesa Sanpaolo; it still needs regulatory authorisation.

events.title: Top US banks plan a shared tokenised deposit network
events.summary: The largest US banks, including JPMorgan Chase, Citigroup, Bank of America and Wells Fargo, are building a joint tokenised deposit network to compete with stablecoins.

events.title: Visa and Brale test private stablecoin settlement on Canton
events.summary: Brale and Visa started a proof of concept settling in Brale's dollar stablecoin SBC on the Canton Network to test privacy-preserving institutional settlement. Visa will weigh SBC as an extra settlement option.

events.title: Mastercard adds USDC and PYUSD settlement plus weekend settlement
events.summary: Mastercard will settle transactions in several regulated US dollar stablecoins, including USDC and PYUSD, alongside fiat, and plans weekend and holiday settlement.

events.title: AX Coin becomes first licensed stablecoin issuer in Bahrain
events.summary: The CBB licensed AX Coin, a unit of Nasdaq-listed SOLOWIN (AXG), to issue stablecoins; the company says it is the first firm licensed under the 2025 issuance module. The peg currency was not disclosed.

events.title: MoneyGram launches MGUSD stablecoin on Stellar, issued by Bridge
events.summary: MoneyGram launched MGUSD, a dollar stablecoin issued by Stripe's Bridge on Stellar, starting with US users and planned for its 60 million customers worldwide.

events.title: Fireblocks launches Flow for stablecoin acceptance by PSPs
events.summary: Fireblocks launched Flow, letting payment service providers and fintechs accept stablecoin payments with settlement and reconciliation built in; Flutterwave is a launch partner.

events.title: Deel launches DLUSD stablecoin wallet for contractors on Tempo
events.summary: Payroll platform Deel launched DLUSD, a dollar stablecoin, and a wallet for its contractors in 150 countries to hold and earn on balances, built with Stripe and exclusively on Tempo.

events.title: Checkout.com merchants can accept USDC and USDT via Coinbase Payments
events.summary: Checkout.com integrated Coinbase Payments so eligible enterprise merchants can accept USDC and USDT and receive settlement in US dollars.

events.title: OpenPayd agrees SPAC merger with Titan for a Nasdaq listing
events.summary: OpenPayd agreed to combine with Titan Acquisition Corp at a pro forma equity value near $1.15bn, with up to $276m of trust proceeds. It would trade on Nasdaq, with closing expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.

deal.rationale: Nasdaq listing through a SPAC merger

events.title: OpenPayd secures MiCA CASP authorisation from Malta's MFSA
events.summary: Malta's MFSA authorised OpenPayd as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider shortly before the 1 July 2026 transition deadline, letting it passport stablecoin on- and off-ramping across the EEA.

events.title: NALA secures a $50m credit facility to pre-fund stablecoin payouts
events.summary: NALA, a global stablecoin payments company, secured a $50m credit facility from Liquidity to pre-fund customer wallets and add corridors, while still holding over half of its 2024 $40m equity round.

round.use_of_funds: pre-funding wallets and new payment corridors

events.title: Aave Labs' Push wins FCA crypto registration for UK stablecoin ramps
events.summary: Push Labs and Push Virtual Assets, Aave Labs' UK units, registered with the FCA for cryptoasset activities on top of their e-money authorisation, to offer regulated, zero-fee stablecoin on- and off-ramps in the UK.

events.title: Cash App rolls out stablecoins to its nearly 60 million users
events.summary: Block began a phased rollout of stablecoin features in Cash App, reaching 25% of users with all to follow within the week, CoinDesk reported.

events.title: Anchorage issues Falcon's fUSD stablecoin with rewards on Ceffu
events.summary: Falcon Finance launched fUSD, a GENIUS-ready stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank with monthly attestations, offering qualifying institutions rewards on Binance's Ceffu custody platform.

events.title: SoFi brings its bank-issued SoFiUSD to 15 million members
events.summary: SoFi launched SoFiUSD, a dollar stablecoin on Ethereum and Solana issued by a US national bank, letting its members trade and transfer it in the app, with yield to follow.

events.title: Mastercard wins a New York BitLicense for its stablecoin push
events.summary: Mastercard secured a New York BitLicense from NYDFS, allowing digital asset activities under one of the strictest US regimes as it builds stablecoin and blockchain settlement.

events.title: Indonesia's OJK rejects Fasset's crypto trader licence application
events.summary: OJK rejected PT Gerbang Aset Digital, Fasset's Indonesian arm, as a digital financial asset trader, revoked its registration as a prospective crypto trader and barred it from crypto business in Indonesia, telling it to settle its obligations to customers.

events.title: Tether to launch an official Georgian lari stablecoin
events.summary: Tether said it will launch a token representing the Georgian lari with government support, Reuters reported.

events.title: IHC moves AED 110m in DDSC on ADI Chain
events.summary: IHC executed an AED 110m (≈$30m) transfer in DDSC, which it called one of the region's largest single stablecoin transactions, marking a shift from pilots to live institutional use of the dirham token.

events.title: European Commission consults on whether MiCA is still fit for purpose
events.summary: The European Commission opened a consultation on whether MiCA, enacted in 2023, needs updating as crypto markets and global rules change.

events.title: Coinbase's custom stablecoin service launches with Flipcash's USDF
events.summary: Flipcash launched USDF, a dollar stablecoin backed by USDC and built on Coinbase's Custom Stablecoins platform, which lets companies issue branded tokens.

events.title: Catena Labs raises $30m Series A for an AI-native bank
events.summary: Catena Labs, Circle co-founder Sean Neville's start-up building financial tools for AI agents, raised a $30m Series A co-led by Acrew Capital and a16z crypto with Breyer Capital, General Catalyst and QED, after an $18m first round in 2025.

round.use_of_funds: banking tools for AI agents

events.title: AllUnity plans a Swedish krona stablecoin and agent payments
events.summary: AllUnity, backed by DWS and Galaxy, targets a June launch for SEKAU, a Swedish krona stablecoin, and is moving into AI agent payments.

events.title: Qivalis euro stablecoin consortium grows to 37 banks
events.summary: Twenty-five more lenders, including ABN AMRO, Intesa Sanpaolo, Nordea and Rabobank, joined Qivalis, taking the group to 37 banks. It has applied to the Dutch central bank for an e-money licence and targets a H2 2026 launch.

events.title: zerohash raises above a $1.5bn valuation as Mastercard steps back
events.summary: Mastercard dropped plans to invest in zerohash after buying BVNK for $1.8bn, a source told CoinDesk. Chicago-based zerohash is now raising fresh capital at a valuation above the $1.5bn discussed in January.

events.title: Dubai's Wego accepts stablecoins for flights through Triple-A
events.summary: Travel platform Wego, based in Dubai, began accepting stablecoins and other crypto for flight and travel bookings through Triple-A, while settling in local currency.

events.title: Trump orders regulators to review fintech access to Fed payment rails
events.summary: An executive order asked the Federal Reserve to review, within 120 days, how non-bank fintechs and crypto firms could get master accounts and Fed services such as Fedwire, and told other regulators to streamline fintech rules.

events.title: Checker raises $8m seed for institutional stablecoin infrastructure
events.summary: Checker, a stablecoin infrastructure start-up, closed an $8m seed round with Galaxy Ventures, Framework Ventures and Al Mada Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin infrastructure for financial institutions

events.title: Aryze closes €3m pre-Series A for managed stablecoin infrastructure
events.summary: Copenhagen-founded Aryze, which runs stablecoin technology as a managed service for licensed stablecoin and tokenised asset issuers, closed a €3m pre-Series A to develop its core platform.

round.use_of_funds: its platform for licensed stablecoin and tokenised asset issuers

events.title: Modern Treasury launches global USD accounts with stablecoin support
events.summary: Modern Treasury launched Global USD Accounts so platforms can give users in more than 90 countries named US dollar accounts with ACH, wire, RTP, FedNow and stablecoin support.

events.title: Tether invests in remittance app LemFi to settle in USDT
events.summary: Tether invested an undisclosed sum in LemFi, a cross-border finance app for people who live and work abroad, to expand stablecoin-powered remittances across emerging markets.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin remittances in emerging markets

events.title: Zodia backers accept Standard Chartered bid for custody unit
events.summary: Zodia's shareholders and noteholders accepted Standard Chartered's non-binding offer for the regulated custody arm, which will join the bank's securities services unit. The infrastructure side becomes Zodia Solutions under SC Ventures.

deal.rationale: fold regulated custody into the bank's securities services

events.title: zerohash adds Dutch e-money licence to its MiCA authorisation
events.summary: De Nederlandsche Bank granted zerohash europe an e-money institution licence, which the firm says makes it the first MiCA-licensed company with EMI status, firming up the legal basis for its stablecoin payment flows in the EEA.

events.title: Fasset raises $51m Series B for stablecoin-based banking
events.summary: Fasset, which holds a Dubai VARA broker-dealer licence, raised $51m from SBI Group, Arz Portföy, Investcorp and family offices to expand its banking corridors and add lending and trade finance.

round.use_of_funds: banking corridors, new markets, and lending, SME banking and trade finance

events.title: Turnkey raises $12.5m with Circle Ventures and Archetype
events.summary: Wallet and key-management infrastructure firm Turnkey raised $12.5m in a strategic round from Archetype, Circle Ventures and existing investors including Sequoia, taking its total past $65m, mainly to launch Turnkey Verifiable Cloud.

round.use_of_funds: launching Turnkey Verifiable Cloud

events.title: Boundary raises $2m pre-seed led by Galaxy for stablecoin USBD
events.summary: Boundary raised a $2m pre-seed, closed in December 2025 and led by Galaxy Ventures with First Block Capital and BlackWood, to build USBD, an institutional stablecoin with daily on-chain reserve audits, due on Ethereum in summer 2026.

round.use_of_funds: developing USBD and its yield-bearing companion token sUSBD

events.title: Neuberger Berman provides $200m facility to Ripple Prime
events.summary: Ripple Prime, the prime broker Ripple bought as Hidden Road in 2025 and whose revenue has tripled since, secured a $200m funding facility from Neuberger Berman to expand margin financing across traditional and digital markets.

round.use_of_funds: margin financing at Ripple Prime

events.title: Senate Banking Committee unveils CLARITY Act text before markup
events.summary: The Senate Banking Committee released the latest text of the CLARITY Act, the crypto market structure bill, ahead of its committee vote.

events.title: Stablecoin bank Augustus raises $40m and wins a rare OCC charter
events.summary: Augustus, founded in 2022 and already licensed in Europe to clear cross-border euro payments for clients such as Kraken, raised $40m from Valar Ventures and Creandum and won an OCC national bank charter to rebuild correspondent banking.

round.use_of_funds: a US clearing bank for dollar payments

events.title: Kraken's parent applies for an OCC national trust charter
events.summary: Payward applied to the OCC for a federally regulated trust company offering crypto custody, adding to the group's Wyoming bank charter and Fed master account.

events.title: Exodus launches XO Cash for AI agent payments on Solana
events.summary: Exodus launched XO Cash, a dollar stablecoin on Solana built with MoonPay, with a toolkit that lets AI agents pay for services without holding users' private keys.

events.title: Mastercard and Yellow Card partner on stablecoin payments across EEMEA
events.summary: Mastercard and Yellow Card partnered to advance stablecoin payments in Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa, including cross-border remittances and digital loyalty.

events.title: Kraken's parent agrees to buy stablecoin payments firm Reap for $600m
events.summary: Payward, Kraken's parent, agreed to buy Hong Kong-based Reap Technologies, which links business payments with digital assets and stablecoin settlement, in a $600m cash-and-stock deal valuing Payward at $20bn, per Bloomberg.

deal.rationale: stablecoin and payments infrastructure in Asia

events.title: AWS launches stablecoin payments for AI agents with Coinbase, Stripe
events.summary: Amazon Web Services launched Bedrock AgentCore Payments, letting AI agents buy APIs, web content and online services with stablecoins, built with Coinbase and Stripe; bookings and merchant payments are to follow.

events.title: USDU and AE Coin plan automated dollar-dirham token conversion
events.summary: An MoU between USDU's issuer, AE Coin and Al Maryah Community Bank aims to build near-instant conversion between the USD and AED payment tokens, with first access via custodian Changer and broker Aquanow.

events.title: Rain's Dubai arm wins VARA in-principle approval
events.summary: Rain MENA FZE got in-principle approval from Dubai's VARA for exchange, broker-dealer and margin trading services, adding a Dubai path to Rain's existing CBB and ADGM licences.

events.title: OpenTrade raises $17m to link stablecoin yield to real-world assets
events.summary: London-based OpenTrade, which lets fintechs offer stablecoin yield products backed by real-world assets, raised $17m led by Mercury Fund and Notion Capital with a16z crypto, AlbionVC and CMCC Global, taking its total past $30m.

round.use_of_funds: permissioned and permissionless infrastructure, asset management and trading teams

events.title: Corpay adds stablecoin settlement through BVNK and Kinexys
events.summary: Corpay signed agreements with J.P. Morgan's Kinexys and BVNK to add stablecoin and tokenised fiat settlement to its cross-border payments platform.

events.title: BNY expands digital asset custody to Abu Dhabi
events.summary: BNY, the world's largest custodian, is bringing its digital asset custody business to Abu Dhabi through local partners Finstreet and the ADI Foundation, starting with bitcoin and ether.

events.title: Solana and Google Cloud let AI agents pay for APIs in stablecoins
events.summary: The Solana Foundation and Google Cloud launched Pay.sh, so AI agents can find and pay per request in stablecoins for Google Cloud services such as Gemini and BigQuery and over 50 community APIs.

events.title: Slash launches stablecoin-funded Visa cards for firms abroad
events.summary: Slash Financial launched Global Cards, Visa cards for international businesses without a US entity, running on Rain's infrastructure and Slash's USDSL stablecoin.

events.title: Kraken and MoneyGram link crypto to cash at retail locations
events.summary: Kraken partnered with MoneyGram so users can convert between crypto and cash through MoneyGram's network, while its co-chief executive said the exchange is '80% ready' to go public.

events.title: MoonPay buys Solana trade router DFlow in a stock deal
events.summary: MoonPay acquired DFlow, a Solana trade router and DEX aggregator, for a reported $100m in stock, its sixth acquisition since early 2025, adding trading to its payments stack.

deal.rationale: add trading to its payments stack

events.title: Tetra launches CADD Canadian-dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Tetra Trust launched CADD, a one-to-one Canadian-dollar stablecoin approved by Alberta's finance ministry, on Ethereum, Base and Tempo, with backers including Wealthsimple, Shopify, National Bank and ATB.

events.title: Western Union launches USDPT stablecoin issued by Anchorage
events.summary: Western Union launched USDPT, a dollar stablecoin on Solana issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, for treasury and agent settlement, starting in the Philippines and Bolivia. Fireblocks provides the wallet infrastructure.

events.title: FIS and six US banks launch Project Keystone for bank-run tokens
events.summary: FIS announced Project Keystone, a network for tokenised money built on regulated deposits and controlled by banks, with Citizens, Fifth Third, Huntington, KeyBank and M&T among the first participants.

events.title: Bakkt completes its purchase of stablecoin firm DTR
events.summary: Bakkt completed its all-stock acquisition of Distributed Technologies Research, issuing 11.3m shares and combining its licences with DTR's agentic payments and stablecoin infrastructure.

deal.rationale: stablecoin and agentic payments infrastructure

events.title: KuCoin and Lightnet explore a South-East Asia payments tie-up
events.summary: KuCoin and Lightnet said they are exploring collaboration that would combine KuCoin's trading ecosystem with Lightnet's licensed cross-border settlement network across South-East Asia, within local regulatory frameworks.

events.title: MoonPay buys MPC security firm Sodot in a $100m stock deal
events.summary: MoonPay acquired Israeli MPC custody technology firm Sodot in an all-stock deal worth about $100m, per Bloomberg, to underpin MoonPay Institutional, a new unit for financial institutions led by former acting CFTC chair Caroline Pham.

deal.rationale: custody technology for a new institutional business

events.title: Coinbase lists tGBP, its first sterling stablecoin
events.summary: Coinbase listed tGBP, a pound-backed stablecoin issued by BCP Technologies, for users worldwide from 22 April.

events.title: Bank-backed euro stablecoin venture Qivalis picks Fireblocks
events.summary: Amsterdam-based Qivalis, formed by twelve European banks including BNP Paribas, ING and UniCredit, chose Fireblocks for issuance, custody and compliance tooling for its MiCA euro stablecoin, due in H2 2026 subject to DNB approval.

events.title: UK plans one payments framework for stablecoins and tokenised deposits
events.summary: HM Treasury set out plans for a single, coherent framework covering traditional and tokenised payments, including stablecoins and tokenised deposits, and to consult on payments by AI agents.

events.title: Nium adds USDC payments for its clients through Coinbase
events.summary: Nium made USDC payouts, treasury and card programmes live for its clients, with Coinbase as stablecoin payments and liquidity infrastructure, wallet provider and regulated custodian.

events.title: Tether leads $8m round in Abu Dhabi tokenisation firm KAIO
events.summary: Abu Dhabi-headquartered KAIO, which tokenises institutional funds from managers such as BlackRock and Hamilton Lane, raised $8m led by Tether, taking its total to $19m, and plans an on-chain fund with Mubadala Capital.

round.use_of_funds: credit, structured products, ETFs and channelling USDT into regulated products

events.title: Meow adds stablecoin payments for business customers through BVNK
events.summary: Meow, a business banking fintech for global teams and AI agents backed by Tiger Global and QED, partnered with BVNK to power stablecoin and crypto payments for its customers.

events.title: Circle France wins AMF approval for MiCA custody and transfers
events.summary: The AMF cleared Circle's French entity under MiCA to offer custody and transfer services for USDC and EURC, which it can passport across the EEA. The AMF register records the licence date as 23 April.

events.title: MoneyGram and NALA partner on stablecoin-settled payouts
events.summary: MoneyGram and NALA, a stablecoin payments company, partnered to power cross-border payouts into emerging markets with stablecoin settlement.

events.title: Crossmint's Lobster.cash plugs AI agents into Mastercard Agent Pay
events.summary: Crossmint's Lobster.cash integrated Mastercard Agent Pay so AI agents in the Openclaw ecosystem can pay with users' existing Mastercard cards under issuer controls.

events.title: Bastion applies to turn its New York trust into a national trust bank
events.summary: Bastion applied to the OCC to convert its New York limited purpose trust charter into Bastion Platforms National Trust Company; an adviser said a national charter removes much of the complexity of white-label stablecoins nationwide.

events.title: SG-FORGE brings its USD CoinVertible stablecoin to MetaMask
events.summary: Société Générale-FORGE partnered with Consensys to make its USD CoinVertible stablecoin available to MetaMask's millions of users.

events.title: Tether joins $134m raise for Stablecoin Development Corporation
events.summary: Tether Investments took part in a $134m financing for Stablecoin Development Corporation, an NYSE American-listed firm offering public-market access to the stablecoin economy, alongside R01 Fund and Framework Ventures.

events.title: eToro agrees to buy self-custody wallet Zengo for about $70m
events.summary: Trading platform eToro agreed to acquire crypto wallet Zengo in a deal estimated at around $70m, moving into self-custody with wallet technology meant to protect users' assets.

deal.rationale: self-custodial wallet technology for its users

events.title: Banking Circle gets CSSF MiCA licence and adds stablecoin settlement
events.summary: Luxembourg's CSSF authorised Banking Circle as a MiCA CASP. The bank followed with round-the-clock fiat-stablecoin conversion and settlement in USDC, USDG and its own EURI.

events.title: Deutsche Börse buys 1.5% of Kraken for $200m
events.summary: Deutsche Börse took a 1.5% stake in Kraken for $200m, deepening a partnership begun in December to bridge traditional and digital markets for institutions in Europe.

round.use_of_funds: a strategic stake alongside the two firms' partnership

events.title: Quantoz adds zloty and sterling e-money tokens
events.summary: Quantoz launched PLNQ and GBPQ on Ethereum, bringing it to five regulated tokens, with Zodia Markets supporting initial OTC distribution.

events.title: ClearBank Europe gains MiCA clearance and plugs into Circle Mint
events.summary: ClearBank Europe says it is the first Dutch credit institution cleared by the AFM for MiCA crypto services, and will connect to Circle Mint so institutional clients can access EURC and USDC.

events.title: Hong Kong grants first stablecoin licences to HSBC and Anchorpoint
events.summary: The HKMA issued Hong Kong's first stablecoin issuer licences under its Stablecoins Ordinance to HSBC and Anchorpoint Financial, the Standard Chartered-led venture, effective 10 April.

events.title: Thunes joins Circle Payments Network's managed payments
events.summary: Thunes joined Circle Payments Network Managed Payments, so its customers can settle with stablecoins while keeping their fiat workflows.

events.title: UBS and five Swiss banks launch a joint Swiss franc stablecoin sandbox
events.summary: UBS, PostFinance, Sygnum, Raiffeisen, Zürcher Kantonalbank, BCV and Swiss Stablecoin AG launched a sandbox to test uses for a Swiss franc stablecoin and connect blockchain applications with the franc.

events.title: Polygon Labs seeks up to $100m for its stablecoin payments business
events.summary: Polygon Labs is in the early stages of raising $50m to $100m in equity to build out its Open Money Stack stablecoin payments business, The Information reported. No round has been announced.

round.use_of_funds: the Open Money Stack payments platform

events.title: FinCEN and OFAC propose AML rules for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: A joint proposal would treat permitted stablecoin issuers as BSA financial institutions with AML and sanctions programmes, able to block or freeze transactions, with a $5,000 suspicious activity threshold.

events.title: FDIC proposes prudential rules for bank stablecoin units
events.summary: The FDIC proposed GENIUS Act standards for stablecoin subsidiaries of its banks, including full reserves, redemption within two days and a $5m capital floor, and a presumption against yield paid via affiliates.

events.title: Tether gives investors two weeks to commit at a $500bn valuation
events.summary: Tether will likely postpone its fundraising if too few investors commit within two weeks, The Information reported. It has been raising since late 2025 but met investor concerns about the $500bn valuation it is seeking.

events.title: Kulipa raises $6.2m seed for stablecoin card issuing
events.summary: Kulipa, which provides stablecoin card issuing infrastructure to fintechs, raised a $6.2m seed co-led by Flourish Ventures and 1kx to expand regulated issuing in Europe, Latin America and Africa.

round.use_of_funds: regulated card issuing in more regions

events.title: BitGo launches BitGo Mint for institutional stablecoin issuance
events.summary: BitGo launched BitGo Mint so institutional clients can mint, redeem and manage stablecoins from one interface alongside its custody, starting with SoFiUSD and USD1.

events.title: Coinbase wins conditional OCC approval for a national trust company
events.summary: Coinbase received conditional OCC approval for Coinbase National Trust Company, bringing its institutional custody business under federal supervision. The trust will not take retail deposits.

events.title: Rain and Episode Six expand stablecoin cards in Asia-Pacific
events.summary: Rain partnered with card processor Episode Six to power stablecoin credit, debit and prepaid card programmes for enterprise clients across Asia-Pacific.

events.title: Merge launches named euro IBANs for fiat-stablecoin payments
events.summary: Merge, a regulated fintech backed by Octopus Ventures and Coinbase, launched named EUR IBANs so businesses can give their users dedicated euro accounts for collection, reconciliation and payouts.

events.title: OpenFX raises $94m for stablecoin-powered cross-border FX
events.summary: OpenFX, founded in 2024 to move large cross-border sums using stablecoins and handling over $45bn of annualised volume, raised $94m led by Accel, Lightspeed Faction, M13, Northzone and Pantera, at about a $500m valuation per Reuters.

round.use_of_funds: expansion into Southeast Asia and Latin America

events.title: Latitude raises $8m led by NEA for stablecoin global payouts
events.summary: Latitude, founded by former Stripe and Coinbase staff and offering stablecoin-based global payouts, raised $8m led by NEA with Lightspeed Faction, Coinbase, Paxos and the Solana Foundation.

events.title: Better Money raises $10m seed for a stablecoin clearinghouse
events.summary: The Better Money Company, founded by former a16z crypto investor Sam Broner, raised a $10m seed led by a16z crypto with BoxGroup and Sunflower Capital to build a clearinghouse where firms can cheaply exchange different dollar stablecoins.

round.use_of_funds: a stablecoin clearinghouse

events.title: Wirex and Crossmint make stablecoins spendable by card
events.summary: Wirex expanded its work with Crossmint: Wirex handles card issuance, bank accounts and payment rails while Crossmint provides wallets and stablecoin orchestration.

events.title: Miami's XFX raises $17m Series A for fiat and stablecoin FX
events.summary: Miami-based XFX, which builds foreign exchange and payment infrastructure for moving between cash and stablecoins, raised $17m led by Castle Island Ventures with Haun Ventures and Coinbase Ventures, after a $9m seed.

events.title: Circle Ventures leads Tazapay's Series B extension, total $36m
events.summary: Circle Ventures led an extension that took Tazapay's Series B to $36m, with new investors CMT Digital and Coinbase Ventures and Ripple among existing backers, to widen corridors across Asia, Latin America and the Middle East.

round.use_of_funds: cross-border corridors across Asia, Latin America and the Middle East

events.title: Canada's Stablecoin Act becomes law with Bank of Canada oversight
events.summary: Bill C-15, carrying the Stablecoin Act, received Royal Assent, giving the Bank of Canada supervisory, registry and penalty powers. Issuers face par redemption, segregated reserves and a ban on paying yield.

events.title: Payy raises $6m seed for private stablecoin payments
events.summary: New York-based Payy, building a zero-knowledge network and wallet that keep USDC payments private, announced a $6m seed led by FirstMark Capital, taking its total to $8m; it has over 100,000 users.

round.use_of_funds: mainnet launch and enterprise payments

events.title: Monument Bank to tokenise up to £250m of retail deposits
events.summary: UK challenger Monument Bank plans to tokenise up to £250m of retail deposits on the Midnight blockchain, keeping them interest-bearing, fully backed and covered by the FSCS.

events.title: BMO launches tokenised cash and deposits with CME and Google Cloud
events.summary: BMO became the first bank to offer CME Group's tokenised cash on Google Cloud's Universal Ledger, letting clients move funds 24/7 for margin calls, trading and settlement.
