events.title: Deloitte Canada and Stablecorp build QCAD rails for banks
events.summary: Deloitte Canada and Stablecorp formed an alliance to deliver QCAD-based stablecoin infrastructure to Canadian financial institutions.

events.title: MoonPay open-sources a wallet standard for AI agents
events.summary: MoonPay launched the Open Wallet Standard, an open-source standard for AI agents to hold and move money, with contributions from PayPal, Ripple, Circle, Polygon and others.

events.title: CLARITY Act draft bars rewards on stablecoin balances
events.summary: Draft text of the Senate's crypto market structure bill would not allow rewards on stablecoin balances or anything resembling a bank deposit, leaving activity-based rewards uncertain, CoinDesk reported.

events.title: TransFi raises $19.2m led by Turing Financial Group
events.summary: TransFi, a payments infrastructure firm on stablecoin rails focused on emerging markets, raised $19.2m: a $14.2m Series A and a $5m committed liquidity facility, led by Turing Financial Group.

round.use_of_funds: scaling stablecoin payments in emerging markets

events.title: Tempo mainnet goes live with a protocol for AI-agent payments
events.summary: Tempo switched on its payments layer-1 mainnet and published the open-source Machine Payments Protocol, co-written with Stripe, for payments by AI agents. Visa, Stripe and Lightspark extended it to other rails.

events.title: Thunes lets 11,500 Swift banks pay into stablecoin wallets
events.summary: Thunes opened its Pay-to-Stablecoin-Wallets service to the 11,500 institutions on Swift, so banks can send real-time payments to over 500 million stablecoin wallets with no new integration.

events.title: PayPal opens PYUSD to users in 70 markets
events.summary: PayPal made its PYUSD stablecoin available in accounts across 70 markets, letting users buy, hold, send and receive it and cash out to local currency. Early markets included the US, the UK and several Latin American countries.

events.title: Mastercard agrees to buy BVNK for up to $1.8B
events.summary: Mastercard signed a definitive deal for the London stablecoin infrastructure firm, worth up to $1.8B including $300M in contingent payments, months after BVNK’s talks with Coinbase collapsed.

deal.rationale: connect on-chain payments with fiat rails

events.title: Ripple to buy BC Payments Australia for an Australian licence
events.summary: Ripple plans to acquire BC Payments Australia to gain an Australian Financial Services Licence and offer its full payments stack there, taking it past 75 licences worldwide; it said Asia-Pacific volume nearly doubled in 2025.

deal.rationale: an Australian licence for its full payments stack

events.title: SquareFi emerges with stablecoin infrastructure for B2B payments
events.summary: SquareFi came out of stealth with stablecoin-based infrastructure for global business payments, already serving fintechs and platforms with $250m in transaction volume.

events.title: KAST raises $80m at a $600m valuation for its stablecoin neobank
events.summary: KAST, an 18-month-old stablecoin payments app with a claimed 1 million users, raised an $80m Series A at a $600m valuation and targets $100m in annual revenue.

round.use_of_funds: growing its stablecoin accounts and cards

events.title: Tether invests in treasury and settlement firm Axiym
events.summary: Tether made a strategic investment in Axiym, which builds treasury and settlement infrastructure inside regulated payment networks, including pay-now-settle-later, so payment firms can use USDT where their dollars already sit.

round.use_of_funds: USDT flows inside regulated payment ecosystems

events.title: Kraken becomes the first crypto firm with a Fed master account
events.summary: Kraken Financial received approval for a Federal Reserve master account, speeding deposits and withdrawals for large clients, though it cannot earn interest on reserves or use emergency lending.

events.title: Crossmint supports Western Union's USDPT stablecoin on Solana
events.summary: Crossmint partnered with Western Union to support USDPT, its new dollar stablecoin on Solana, and the Digital Asset Network that links digital dollars to over 360,000 cash payout points.

events.title: VersaBank starts US pilot of USDVB tokenised deposits
events.summary: VersaBank began an internal US pilot of USDVB, the dollar version of its tokenised bank deposits, and refreshed its Canadian-dollar pilot as it moves the product towards commercial use.

events.title: Yuno adds Conduit's stablecoin rails for its merchants
events.summary: Payments orchestrator Yuno made Conduit's stablecoin rails available to merchants within their existing integrations, offering settlement in roughly 15 to 20 minutes and virtual dollar, euro and sterling accounts.

events.title: Visa and Bridge target 100+ countries for stablecoin-backed cards
events.summary: Visa and Stripe's Bridge widened their stablecoin-backed card product, live in 18 countries, aiming for over 100 by year-end with Europe and the Middle East among target regions. Bridge also underpins on-chain settlement in Visa's pilot.

events.title: Morgan Stanley applies for a national trust bank for digital assets
events.summary: Morgan Stanley applied to the OCC for a national trust bank charter for a standalone digital asset entity, as it prepares spot crypto trading for E*Trade clients with zerohash.

events.title: AllUnity launches CHFAU Swiss franc stablecoin
events.summary: AllUnity issued CHFAU, a fully reserved Swiss franc e-money token aligned with MiCA, on Ethereum, with more chains planned during 2026.

events.title: FCA picks four firms to test stablecoins in its sandbox
events.summary: The FCA chose Monee Financial Technologies, ReStabilise, Revolut and VVTX from 20 applicants to test stablecoin services against its proposed rules in the Regulatory Sandbox.

events.title: OCC proposes GENIUS Act rules for the issuers it oversees
events.summary: The OCC proposed GENIUS Act rules for federal and foreign issuers it supervises, requiring one-to-one liquid reserves, tailored capital and liquidity, and redemption at par within two business days.

events.title: Stripe reported to be weighing a bid for all or part of PayPal
events.summary: Bloomberg reported that Stripe, valued at $159bn and owner of Bridge, was considering buying all or parts of PayPal, issuer of the PYUSD stablecoin through Paxos; PayPal shares rose 7%.

deal.rationale: combine two payment firms that both use stablecoins

events.title: Stable Sea and dLocal partner on B2B stablecoin payments
events.summary: Stable Sea partnered with dLocal to use dLocal's local payment rails in more than 40 countries for its business stablecoin payouts and settlement.

events.title: RedotPay said to prepare a New York IPO of over $1bn
events.summary: Hong Kong-based stablecoin payments firm RedotPay is preparing a US listing that could raise more than $1bn, and has hired JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Jefferies, Bloomberg reported. No deal has been announced.

round.use_of_funds: a US initial public offering

events.title: Payoneer applies to the OCC to open a stablecoin-focused bank
events.summary: Cross-border payments firm Payoneer applied to the OCC to open a digital bank, calling it the next step in bringing stablecoin capabilities to its nearly 2 million customers.

events.title: MoonPay launches MoonPay Agents, money tools for AI agents
events.summary: MoonPay launched MoonPay Agents, non-custodial infrastructure that lets AI agents fund themselves, pay and off-ramp back to fiat.

events.title: Meta plans stablecoin payments in the second half of 2026
events.summary: Meta sent a request for proposals to third parties to help run stablecoin payments and plans a new wallet, with a launch aimed at the second half of the year, sources told CoinDesk.

events.title: Stablecore joins Jack Henry's network to reach 1,600 banks
events.summary: Stablecore joined the Jack Henry Fintech Integration Network so banks and credit unions on its cores can offer stablecoin accounts, tokenised deposits and digital asset services.

events.title: Crypto.com wins conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank
events.summary: Crypto.com received conditional OCC approval to set up Foris DAX National Trust Bank, consolidating its US custody services under federal oversight.

events.title: SG-FORGE brings its euro stablecoin to the XRP Ledger
events.summary: Société Générale's digital assets unit launched EUR CoinVertible on the XRP Ledger, its third blockchain after Ethereum and Solana, with about €65.8m in circulation.

events.title: Anchorage launches stablecoin services for international banks
events.summary: Anchorage Digital launched Stablecoin Solutions for Banks, giving licensed international banks federally regulated stablecoin issuance, custody and US dollar settlement to modernise cross-border payments.

events.title: World Liberty brings USD1 into Apex Group's fund services
events.summary: World Liberty Financial and Apex Group, a fund services firm in 52 countries, agreed to integrate the USD1 stablecoin for subscriptions, distributions and redemptions of tokenised assets.

events.title: Modern Treasury adds stablecoin settlement to its payments platform
events.summary: Modern Treasury launched a payments platform that settles in USDG, USDP and USDC alongside ACH, wires and real-time rails, after buying Beam and partnering with Paxos; USDT is to follow.

events.title: Quantoz becomes a Visa principal member for stablecoin cards
events.summary: Quantoz Payments joined Visa as a principal member, allowing it to issue virtual Visa debit cards that spend e-money and stablecoin balances and to sponsor BINs for European fintechs.

events.title: BVNK wins MiCA CASP licence from Malta's MFSA
events.summary: Malta's financial regulator granted stablecoin payments firm BVNK a MiCA crypto-asset service provider licence, letting it serve the EEA from Malta, where it already held e-money authorisation and now pairs crypto services with direct SEPA access.

events.title: Agant registers with the FCA ahead of GBPA sterling stablecoin
events.summary: Stablecoin issuer Agant won FCA registration as a cryptoasset business under money laundering rules, clearing the way to issue GBPA, a fully backed sterling stablecoin for institutional use.

events.title: Stripe's Bridge wins conditional OCC trust bank approval
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved Bridge, owned by Stripe, to form a national trust bank that could issue stablecoins, hold custody and manage reserves under federal oversight.

events.title: Superset raises $4m seed for stablecoin and on-chain FX liquidity
events.summary: Superset, building a shared liquidity layer for stablecoins, tokenised deposits and on-chain FX, raised $4m from 7RIDGE and Exponential Science Capital; ClearBank co-founder Charles McManus joined as chairman and investor.

events.title: Zodia Markets joins BCB's BLINC instant settlement network
events.summary: Zodia Markets went live on BCB's round-the-clock BLINC network and became a liquidity provider to BCB's OTC desk. BCB also flagged dirham settlement rails for Middle East corridors.

events.title: CBUAE approves launch of DDSC dirham stablecoin on ADI Chain
events.summary: IHC, FAB and Sirius received central bank approval to go live with DDSC, a dirham-backed token on the ADI Chain layer-2 network, aimed at institutional payments, high-value settlement, treasury and trade flows.

events.title: Zand and Ripple explore links between AEDZ and RLUSD stablecoins
events.summary: Zand plans to support custody of Ripple's RLUSD and will explore direct liquidity between RLUSD and its dirham token AEDZ, plus issuing AEDZ on the XRP Ledger. All steps are exploratory and need regulatory approval.

events.title: Fiserv's Clover merchants can take crypto through the Lydian app
events.summary: A Lydian app lets merchants on Fiserv's Clover point-of-sale accept payment in over 300 digital assets, including USDT, while settling in local fiat currency.

events.title: Tether invests $100m in Anchorage Digital at $4.2bn valuation
events.summary: Tether took a $100m strategic equity stake in Anchorage Digital at a $4.2bn valuation, pointing to its use of the bank for USAT issuance, custody and compliance.

events.title: Bitpanda joins Global Dollar Network and lists MiCA-compliant USDG
events.summary: Bitpanda opened USDG trading, deposits and withdrawals for European users. In the EU the token is issued by Paxos Issuance Europe under Finnish supervision and redeemable one-for-one for dollars.

events.title: UK Parliament passes rules bringing stablecoin issuance under FSMA
events.summary: Parliament passed the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026, bringing crypto dealing, custody, stablecoin issuance and staking arrangements within the UK regulatory perimeter for the first time.

events.title: Tether said to cut its raise to about $5bn; its CEO disputes it
events.summary: The FT reported Tether's advisers were discussing a raise of about $5bn, down from up to $20bn, after investors balked at a $500bn valuation. CEO Paolo Ardoino said the larger figures were a maximum, not a target.

events.title: BBVA joins the Qivalis bank consortium for a euro stablecoin
events.summary: BBVA joined Qivalis, the banking consortium developing a regulated euro stablecoin for faster, cheaper payments and the settlement of digital assets.

events.title: Y Combinator lets start-ups take its $500,000 investment in USDC
events.summary: Y Combinator said founders in its Spring 2026 batch can receive the standard $500,000 investment in USDC across major blockchains instead of dollars.

events.title: VersaBank signs QCAD as first stablecoin reserve custody client
events.summary: VersaBank agreed to custody reserves for Stablecorp's QCAD on its VersaVault platform, earning fees on assets held, replacing Tetra Trust as QCAD's reserve custodian.

events.title: NymCard claims GCC first with USDC settlement on Visa
events.summary: Card issuer NymCard launched USDC settlement with Visa and says it is the first issuer in the GCC to do so. Settling in a stablecoin lets it settle around the clock and cuts the collateral and prefunding it must hold.

events.title: Luxembourg's CSSF grants Ripple a full EU e-money licence
events.summary: The CSSF confirmed Ripple's electronic money institution licence weeks after a conditional green light, giving Ripple an EU-regulated base from which to expand Ripple Payments across the bloc.

events.title: CBUAE registers USDU as the first Foreign Payment Token
events.summary: The central bank registered USDU, a dollar stablecoin from ADGM-regulated Universal Digital, under its payment token rules; CoinDesk calls it the first USD token cleared this way. Aquanow is a distribution partner outside the UAE.

events.title: Mesh raises $75m Series C at $1bn valuation led by Dragonfly
events.summary: Crypto payments network Mesh closed a $75m Series C led by Dragonfly, valuing it at $1bn and taking total funding past $200m. Part of the round was settled in stablecoins.

round.use_of_funds: expansion into Latin America, Asia and Europe, and product development

events.title: Tether's US stablecoin USAT launches with Anchorage as issuer
events.summary: Tether's US-focused stablecoin USAT began trading on Kraken, Crypto.com and other venues, issued by OCC-supervised Anchorage Digital Bank, with Cantor Fitzgerald holding the reserves.

events.title: zerohash in talks to raise $250m at a $1.5bn valuation
events.summary: After walking away from Mastercard's takeover approach to stay independent, zerohash was in talks to raise $250m at a $1.5bn valuation, according to a source cited by CoinDesk; Mastercard was said to be weighing an investment.

events.title: Ripple and Riyad Bank's Jeel sign MoU on blockchain payments
events.summary: Ripple agreed with Jeel, the innovation unit of Riyad Bank, to study blockchain use in cross-border payments, digital asset custody and tokenisation. Stablecoins were not named in the scope.

events.title: Capital One agrees to buy Brex for $5.15bn
events.summary: Capital One agreed to acquire Brex, the corporate card and spend platform that added stablecoin payments in 2025, for $5.15bn split evenly between cash and stock, expanding its business payments strategy.

deal.rationale: business payments technology and clients

events.title: BitGo lists on the NYSE after a $213m IPO at $18 a share
events.summary: Crypto custodian BitGo priced its IPO at $18 a share, above its $15 to $17 range, raising $213m at a valuation above $2bn; the shares opened at $22.43 on the NYSE. It was last valued at $1.75bn in a 2023 Series C.

events.title: zerohash walks away from Mastercard takeover to stay independent
events.summary: zerohash ended takeover talks with Mastercard, reported in October at $1.5bn to $2bn, saying it was "not entertaining an acquisition"; Mastercard was said to be weighing a strategic investment instead.

deal.rationale: zerohash chose to remain independent

events.title: WSPN partners with HIFI on stablecoin-fiat conversion
events.summary: Worldwide Stablecoin Payment Network (WSPN) partnered with licensed payments infrastructure provider HIFI so institutional clients can convert between stablecoins and fiat for cross-border payments.

events.title: Interactive Brokers takes USDC deposits around the clock via zerohash
events.summary: Eligible Interactive Brokers clients can deposit USDC at any time, converted to dollars within minutes, with Ripple's RLUSD to follow; the service runs on zerohash.

events.title: Gusto taps zerohash for stablecoin payouts to workers abroad
events.summary: Payroll and HR platform Gusto partnered with zerohash to offer workers outside the US near-instant payouts in stablecoins, to custodial or self-custodial wallets.

events.title: Swift and SG-FORGE settle tokenised bonds using EURCV
events.summary: Swift orchestrated the issue, delivery-versus-payment, coupons and redemption of tokenised bonds across chains and fiat rails, using SG-FORGE's framework and its EUR CoinVertible token with ISO 20022 messaging.

events.title: Senate Banking Committee cancels its crypto market structure markup
events.summary: The Senate Banking Committee called off its planned vote on the crypto market structure bill as negotiations, including over stablecoin rewards, ran out of time.

events.title: Meld raises $7m to link stablecoin on- and off-ramp networks
events.summary: Meld, a network joining 50+ crypto payment providers in 180+ countries, founded by a Block veteran, raised $7m led by Lightspeed Faction with F-Prime, Yolo Investments and Scytale Digital, taking its total to $15m.

events.title: Polygon Labs agrees to buy Coinme and Sequence for over $250m
events.summary: Polygon Labs signed deals to buy Coinme, whose money transmitter licences cover 48 US states with 50,000 retail cash points, and wallet firm Sequence for more than $250m, to build its Open Money Stack for regulated US stablecoin payments.

deal.rationale: regulated US stablecoin payments for the Open Money Stack

events.title: Noah and NALA build instant stablecoin settlement for Africa and Asia
events.summary: Noah and NALA partnered so businesses in Africa and Asia can collect US dollars anywhere and pay out local currency in minutes, pairing Noah's USD collection with NALA's licensed stablecoin on- and off-ramp network.

events.title: Ingenico brings stablecoin payments to physical checkouts
events.summary: Ingenico, the payment terminal maker, partnered with WalletConnect Pay so merchants can accept supported stablecoins directly at checkout.

events.title: Franklin Templeton adapts a money market fund for stablecoin reserves
events.summary: Franklin Templeton modified its institutional LUIXX money market fund to hold short-term Treasuries and meet stablecoin reserve standards, and gave its DIGXX fund an on-chain share class.

events.title: ClearBank picks Taurus wallet tech to support stablecoin services
events.summary: UK bank ClearBank, which also has an ECB-authorised Dutch arm, chose Taurus-PROTECT as wallet infrastructure for client stablecoin services; Taurus also connects to Circle Mint for minting and redeeming USDC and EURC.

events.title: VelaFi raises $20m Series B for enterprise stablecoin payments
events.summary: VelaFi, a Latin America-based provider of stablecoin payment and treasury infrastructure for enterprises, raised a $20m Series B led by XVC and Ikuyo, taking its total past $40m, to expand in the US and Asia.

round.use_of_funds: expansion across the US and Asia

events.title: BNY goes live with tokenised deposits for collateral and margin
events.summary: BNY launched tokenised deposits for collateral and margin payments, with firms including Anchorage Digital, Paxos, Galaxy, Ripple Prime, Securitize, Talos and zerohash involved.

events.title: Ripple wins UK e-money licence and FCA cryptoasset registration
events.summary: The FCA granted Ripple an electronic money institution licence and cryptoasset registration, allowing it to scale Ripple Payments so UK institutions can move cross-border payments using digital assets.

events.title: BVNK wins direct SEPA access for instant euro payments
events.summary: BVNK became a direct participant in SEPA through the Bank of Lithuania's CENTROlink, with its own accounts on SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant, so it can offer euro and stablecoin payments 24/7 without partner banks.

events.title: World Liberty Financial applies to the OCC for a trust bank
events.summary: World Liberty Financial applied to the OCC to launch World Liberty Trust Company, a national trust bank that would issue its USD1 stablecoin directly.

events.title: Barclays invests in stablecoin clearing firm Ubyx
events.summary: Barclays made an undisclosed investment in Ubyx, which builds clearing for tokenised money such as bank deposits and regulated stablecoins, as UBS, PostFinance and Sygnum also explore regulated on-chain payments.

events.title: J.P. Morgan to issue its JPM Coin deposit token natively on Canton
events.summary: Kinexys by J.P. Morgan and Digital Asset plan to issue JPMD, the bank's dollar deposit token, natively on the Canton Network for 24/7 settlement, in a phased 2026 rollout after its launch on Base.

events.title: Fireblocks buys crypto accounting platform TRES for about $130m
events.summary: Fireblocks agreed to buy TRES Finance, a crypto accounting, reconciliation and reporting platform, for cash and equity worth about $130m, its second deal after buying wallet platform Dynamic for around $90m in October.

deal.rationale: accounting, reconciliation and audit-ready reporting

events.title: RAKBANK gets in-principle nod for a dirham-backed stablecoin
events.summary: The CBUAE gave RAKBANK in-principle approval to issue a stablecoin backed 1:1 by segregated dirham reserves. Ledger Insights calls it the first conventional UAE bank to get this far; launch still needs final sign-off.

events.title: Network International to accept AE Coin at POS and online checkouts
events.summary: Network signed an MoU with Al Maryah Community Bank to add AE Coin as a payment method on its in-store and e-commerce platforms, which it calls a first for a UAE payments processor. No rollout date was set.

events.title: Rain raises $250m Series C led by ICONIQ at a $1.95bn valuation
events.summary: Stablecoin card and payments platform Rain raised $250m led by ICONIQ, valuing it at $1.95bn, more than 17 times its value ten months earlier, and taking its total funding past $338m.

round.use_of_funds: new markets and platform capabilities

events.title: London's Nodu raises $1.45m for a stablecoin layer for banks
events.summary: Nodu, founded in London in 2025 by the team behind Crassula, raised $1.45m pre-seed led by Digital Space Ventures for a plug-in layer that lets banks and licensed fintechs send, receive and hold stablecoins with compliance automated.

round.use_of_funds: European expansion, hiring and partnerships with regulated institutions

events.title: Bank start-up Erebor raises $350m at $4.35bn valuation
events.summary: Erebor, the Columbus-based digital bank co-founded by Palmer Luckey that calls itself stablecoin-native, closed a $350m round valuing it at $4.35bn, Axios reported, weeks after conditional OCC approval.

round.use_of_funds: building a bank for technology, AI and defence companies

events.title: Standard Chartered launches tokenised deposits with Ant International
events.summary: Standard Chartered launched a tokenised deposit service in Singapore dollars and US dollars for 24/7 treasury management, with Ant International as its first client.

events.title: Shift4 launches stablecoin settlement for merchants worldwide
events.summary: Payments processor Shift4 launched a global stablecoin settlement platform that lets merchants receive their funds in stablecoins at any time, faster than through banking rails.

events.title: Coinbax raises $4.2m seed for controls on stablecoin payments
events.summary: Coinbax, which adds programmable escrow and controls to stablecoin payments for banks and credit unions, raised a $4.2m seed led by BankTech Ventures with Connecticut Innovations, Paxos and SpringTime Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: engineering, integrations and onboarding design partners

events.title: Fed seeks comment on 'payment accounts' with basic access to its rails
events.summary: The Federal Reserve opened a 45-day request for information on prototype payment accounts for eligible institutions, without access to Fed credit; Governor Barr opposed it over money-laundering safeguards.

events.title: Klarna raises short-term funding in USDC through Coinbase
events.summary: Klarna partnered with Coinbase to raise short-term funding from institutional investors in USDC, adding stablecoins to a funding mix of deposits, loans and commercial paper.

events.title: SoFi launches SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a US national bank
events.summary: SoFi Bank launched SoFiUSD, a dollar stablecoin backed 1:1 by cash held at the Federal Reserve, for banks, fintechs and enterprises to settle payments.

events.title: Fiserv completes StoneCastle deal, adding FIUSD reserve options
events.summary: Fiserv completed its purchase of StoneCastle Cash Management, combining its insured deposit network with Fiserv's banking and payments platforms and offering financial institutions funding options that include the FIUSD stablecoin.

deal.rationale: insured deposit funding and liquidity for banks and merchants

events.title: Federal Reserve withdraws its 2023 limits on banks' crypto activity
events.summary: The Federal Reserve withdrew its 2023 policy statement that barred state member banks from crypto activities other federal regulators did not allow, saying its understanding of innovative products had evolved.

events.title: Visa brings USDC settlement to US banks after a $3.5bn pilot
events.summary: Visa began letting US issuers and acquirers settle with it in USDC over Solana, starting with Cross River Bank and Lead Bank, after its stablecoin settlement pilot reached a $3.5bn annual run rate.

events.title: Tether leads $8m round in Lightning and USDT payments firm Speed
events.summary: Tether co-led an $8m round with ego death capital in Speed, whose wallet and merchant products settle in bitcoin over Lightning and in USDT for 1.2m users and businesses, handling over $1.5bn a year.

round.use_of_funds: USDT settlement for payments

events.title: RedotPay raises $107m Series B led by Goodwater
events.summary: Hong Kong-based RedotPay, which runs stablecoin cards and cross-border payouts in 100+ countries, raised $107m led by Goodwater Capital with Pantera, Blockchain Capital and Circle Ventures, taking its 2025 total to $194m.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion of stablecoin payments

events.title: Exodus plans a dollar stablecoin issued with MoonPay
events.summary: Listed crypto wallet firm Exodus said it will launch a fully reserved dollar stablecoin with MoonPay to power self-custodial payments in its wallet app.

events.title: FDIC proposes how banks apply to issue stablecoins
events.summary: The FDIC board proposed a GENIUS Act rule on how the banks it supervises apply to issue payment stablecoins through subsidiaries, covering activities, ownership and control, and audit requirements.

events.title: Visa launches a Stablecoins Advisory Practice for banks and fintechs
events.summary: Visa launched a consulting service to help banks, fintechs and merchants plan stablecoin strategies, with early clients including Wirex, Pathward, VyStar and Navy Federal Credit Union.

events.title: UK lays final law for its crypto regime, including stablecoin issuance
events.summary: HM Treasury laid the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2025, creating regulated activities such as running a crypto trading platform and issuing stablecoins.

events.title: PayPal applies for a Utah industrial bank licence
events.summary: PayPal, the issuer of PYUSD, applied for a Utah industrial bank licence to create PayPal Bank, which would offer business lending and interest-bearing savings accounts.

events.title: Circle agrees to buy Interop Labs' team and technology
events.summary: Circle signed an agreement to acquire the team and proprietary technology of Interop Labs, core contributors to the Axelar Network, to strengthen its cross-chain work; the deal was expected to close in early 2026.

deal.rationale: cross-chain interoperability

events.title: Volt adds stablecoin acceptance to its checkout through BVNK
events.summary: Volt, the real-time payments platform, partnered with BVNK to offer stablecoin pay-ins at checkout to its merchants, the first phase of a wider collaboration.

events.title: DFSA scraps recognised token list; firms must judge suitability
events.summary: From 12 Jan 2026, firms in the DIFC must assess and document whether each crypto token is suitable, rather than rely on a DFSA list. Fiat crypto tokens (stablecoins) remain under a separate DFSA policy statement.

events.title: YouTube pays US creators in PYUSD through PayPal
events.summary: YouTube began offering US creators payouts in PayPal's PYUSD stablecoin, with PayPal handling the crypto side so the platform does not touch it directly.

events.title: Singapore Gulf Bank launches zero-fee stablecoin minting on Solana
events.summary: Singapore Gulf Bank let corporate clients mint and redeem USDC and USDT on Solana, waiving transaction and gas fees for a launch period; it says it has processed over $7bn across Asia and the GCC corridor.

events.title: OCC conditionally approves five crypto national trust banks
events.summary: The OCC conditionally approved new national trust banks for Circle and Ripple and conversions for BitGo, Fidelity Digital Assets and Paxos. The charters exclude deposit-taking and carry capital and governance conditions.

events.title: ADNOC Distribution signs MoU to accept AE Coin payments
events.summary: The fuel retailer agreed with Al Maryah Community Bank to let customers pay in AE Coin through the AEC Wallet at its service stations, Oasis stores and car washes. No go-live date was given.

events.title: World App rolls out Bridge-powered accounts for USDC payroll
events.summary: World App's virtual accounts, powered by Stripe's Bridge, let users receive payroll and deposits directly in USDC, and expanded from the US to Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Latin America.

events.title: Klarna works with Privy on crypto wallets for its users
events.summary: Klarna partnered with Stripe-owned Privy to develop crypto wallet features for its users, building on the launch of KlarnaUSD, its dollar stablecoin.

events.title: Anchorage Digital to issue OSL's USDGO stablecoin
events.summary: Anchorage Digital will be the federally regulated US issuer of USDGO, the dollar stablecoin branded by Hong Kong-listed OSL Group.

events.title: Stripe hires the team behind stablecoin app Valora
events.summary: Stripe acqui-hired the team behind Valora, a Celo-based crypto payments app, while its intellectual property returned to cLabs; it adds to Stripe's purchases of Bridge and Privy and its work on Tempo.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments talent

events.title: Tempo opens its public testnet with Mastercard, UBS and Kalshi
events.summary: Tempo, the payments blockchain built by Stripe and Paradigm, launched its public testnet and added partners including Kalshi, Mastercard and UBS.

events.title: Brale's SBC stablecoin funds tokenised Treasury repo on Canton
events.summary: Brale-issued stablecoin SBC served as a funding leg in coordinated tokenised US Treasury repo trades on the Canton Network, as more institutions joined the working group behind them.

events.title: Kraken launches Kraken Ramp, a single API for crypto on-ramps
events.summary: Kraken launched Kraken Ramp, a unified fiat-to-crypto API that lets platforms offer crypto access on Kraken's licensed rails and liquidity, with Kraken handling compliance, KYC and fraud checks behind the scenes.

events.title: ADGM extends USDT acceptance to nine more blockchains
events.summary: Abu Dhabi's FSRA recognised USDT as an Accepted Fiat-Referenced Token on nine more networks, including TRON, TON and Aptos, on top of Ethereum, Solana and Avalanche, so ADGM-licensed firms can use it in regulated activities.

events.title: Dubai Customs signs MoU with Binance on crypto payments for trade
events.summary: Dubai Customs signed a memorandum of understanding with Binance FZE to bring Binance Pay and other crypto payment services into customs, trade and logistics, aiming to cut costs and clearance times for SMEs.

events.title: BNY, Nasdaq, S&P Global and iCapital invest $50m in Digital Asset
events.summary: Digital Asset, the company behind the Canton Network, took a $50m strategic investment from BNY, iCapital, Nasdaq and S&P Global as traditional finance backs regulated blockchain infrastructure.

round.use_of_funds: building out the Canton Network with the investors

events.title: 1Money launches a zero-fee stablecoin orchestration platform
events.summary: 1Money launched 1Money.com, a stablecoin orchestration platform with no platform fees, self-onboarding and gasless transactions on its own network, pitched as a cheaper alternative to Bridge and BVNK.

events.title: OpenPayd powers Altify's euro, sterling and dollar on- and off-ramps
events.summary: Tokenised private markets app Altify partnered with OpenPayd to handle fiat deposits and withdrawals in EUR, GBP and USD for its more than 80,000 users.

events.title: Fin, formerly TipLink, raises $17m led by Pantera
events.summary: Fin, a stablecoin app for sending large sums across borders, raised $17m led by Pantera Capital with Sequoia and Samsung Next.

events.title: Coinbase says it runs stablecoin pilots with large US banks
events.summary: Coinbase is running pilot programmes with some of the largest US banks covering stablecoins, crypto custody and trading, its chief executive said at the New York Times DealBook Summit.

events.title: Navro adds stablecoin payouts through BVNK
events.summary: Navro, which handles international payments for businesses, added stablecoin payments to its rails through BVNK so clients can pay customers, contractors and staff abroad.

events.title: Unlimit launches Stable.com, a clearing house for stablecoins
events.summary: Payments firm Unlimit, founded in 2009, launched Stable.com, a non-custodial clearing house that combines swaps between major stablecoins with fiat off-ramps worldwide.

events.title: UK law recognises crypto and stablecoins as personal property
events.summary: The Property (Digital Assets etc) Act received Royal Assent, confirming digital assets can be owned, recovered after theft or fraud, and included in insolvency and estates.

events.title: Ten-bank euro stablecoin venture named Qivalis, eyes H2 2026
events.summary: European banks including ING, UniCredit and BNP Paribas named their Amsterdam stablecoin joint venture Qivalis, appointed a CEO and chair, and said they had applied to DNB for an e-money licence ahead of a 2026 launch.

events.title: Rain buys Fern for on- and off-ramp routing across chains
events.summary: Rain acquired Fern and its multiplex, a routing, orchestration and compliance engine that connects liquidity providers and bank partners to pick the best path for converting assets across chains.

deal.rationale: reliable on- and off-ramps across chains

events.title: Conduit launches multicurrency accounts for fiat and stablecoins
events.summary: Conduit rolled out virtual accounts and IBANs in dollars, euros and sterling, with pay-ins and payouts in 15 fiat currencies plus USDT and USDC, for clients in more than 100 countries.

events.title: Sony Bank picks Bastion to issue its planned dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Sony Financial Group chose Bastion to handle issuance, reserves and custody for a dollar stablecoin planned by Sony Bank's proposed US trust bank, Connectia Trust, aimed at treasury and in-app payments.

events.title: Lead Bank brings in stablecoin payments start-up Loop Crypto
events.summary: Loop Crypto's team joined Lead Bank, which said their expertise strengthens the regulated, programmable banking it offers to payment companies building on stablecoins.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments expertise

events.title: Abu Dhabi's FSRA accepts RLUSD for use by ADGM-licensed firms
events.summary: ADGM's regulator recognised Ripple's RLUSD as an Accepted Fiat-Referenced Token, so FSRA-authorised firms can use it in regulated activities. It builds on approvals RLUSD had already won from other regulators in the region.

events.title: Polygon partners with Stableport on B2B stablecoin payments
events.summary: Polygon partnered with Stableport to run business-to-business stablecoin payment flows on Polygon PoS through Stableport's network of licensed virtual asset service providers.

events.title: FCA opens a stablecoin cohort in its Regulatory Sandbox
events.summary: The FCA launched a stablecoin cohort in its Regulatory Sandbox so issuers can test products under the UK's coming regime and help shape its rules.

events.title: Deutsche Börse signs MoU to integrate AllUnity's EURAU
events.summary: Deutsche Börse agreed to bring AllUnity's euro stablecoin into its market infrastructure, starting with institutional custody at Clearstream, with Crypto Finance (Germany) acting as sub-custodian.

events.title: Visa adds Aquanow to bring stablecoin settlement to CEMEA clients
events.summary: Visa partnered with Aquanow, which holds a Dubai VARA licence, so issuers and acquirers in Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa can settle with Visa in approved stablecoins such as USDC, every day of the year.

events.title: U.S. Bank pilots its own stablecoin issuance on Stellar
events.summary: U.S. Bancorp, the fifth-largest US commercial bank, is testing custom stablecoin issuance on the Stellar network, including features such as asset freezing and transaction reversal that suit compliance needs.

events.title: MoonPay wins a New York trust charter on top of its BitLicense
events.summary: MoonPay received a New York limited purpose trust charter from NYDFS, letting its new trust company offer crypto custody and OTC trading; it now holds both a BitLicense and a trust charter.

events.title: Klarna launches KlarnaUSD, the first bank-issued token on Tempo
events.summary: Klarna launched KlarnaUSD, its first stablecoin and the first bank-issued token on Tempo, the payments blockchain built by Stripe and Paradigm, to cut the cost of cross-border payments.

events.title: Cross River adds stablecoin payments to its real-time core system
events.summary: Cross River Bank launched a stablecoin payments offering built into COS, its real-time core system, unifying fiat and stablecoin flows within a single platform.

events.title: Paxos acquires MPC wallet and custody provider Fordefi
events.summary: Paxos bought Fordefi, an institutional MPC wallet and custody platform with offices in New York and Tel Aviv, to build out its custody layer. Terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: build out its custody layer with MPC wallet technology

events.title: Exodus agrees to buy W3C, parent of card firms Baanx and Monavate
events.summary: Wallet company Exodus agreed to buy W3C Corp, parent of Baanx and Monavate, gaining card issuing and processing to issue cards on Visa, Mastercard and Discover in the US, UK and EU with stablecoin support. Terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: card issuing and processing for its wallet users

events.title: Canadian regulators clear QCAD stablecoin prospectus
events.summary: Canadian securities regulators receipted the final prospectus of QCAD Digital Trust, allowing distribution of the Canadian-dollar stablecoin run by Stablecorp, which calls it the first regulator-approved CAD coin.

events.title: French on-chain bank Deblock raises €30m Series A
events.summary: Deblock, a French app combining a current account with self-custodial crypto, raised a €30m Series A led by Speedinvest with Commerz Ventures and Latitude, to expand into Germany.

round.use_of_funds: expansion into Germany and across Europe

events.title: HSBC plans wider tokenised deposit service for the first half of 2026
events.summary: HSBC is due to expand its tokenised deposit service, already offered in Hong Kong, Singapore and other markets, with the launch scheduled for the first half of 2026, PYMNTS reported.

events.title: Circle launches xReserve for USDC-backed stablecoins on other chains
events.summary: Circle launched xReserve, infrastructure that lets developers deploy stablecoins fully backed by USDC reserves with 1:1 interoperability across blockchains.

events.title: Deutsche Börse to integrate SG-FORGE's CoinVertible stablecoins
events.summary: Deutsche Börse, Société Générale and SG-FORGE agreed to bring EUR and USD CoinVertible into market infrastructure, starting with collateral and settlement at Clearstream, with listing on group venues planned.

events.title: Riyadh's Palm Azgar launches PUSD, backed by dirham and riyal reserves
events.summary: Palm Azgar Finance Company, a licensed provider in Riyadh, launched PUSD through its British Virgin Islands affiliate, a dollar stablecoin whose reserves are held in UAE dirhams and Saudi riyals at Shariah-compliant institutions.

events.title: Obex raises $37m to incubate stablecoins backed by real-world credit
events.summary: Obex, an incubator for stablecoins backed by compute, energy and fintech credit, raised $37m led by Framework Ventures and Sky, which has committed up to $2.5bn to the projects it backs.

round.use_of_funds: funding new asset-backed stablecoin projects

events.title: MoonPay launches an enterprise stablecoin business built on M0
events.summary: MoonPay launched a business that issues and manages fully reserved stablecoins for enterprises across several blockchains, integrating M0's issuance infrastructure and distributing the tokens through its global network.

events.title: CBUAE clears Zand to launch multi-chain dirham stablecoin
events.summary: Zand won central bank approval for Zand AED, a dirham stablecoin issued by its subsidiary Zand Trust on several public blockchains and backed 1:1 by segregated AED reserves. Zand bills it as the UAE's first of its kind.

events.title: Alibaba to settle B2B payments with J.P. Morgan tokenised deposits
events.summary: Alibaba's global business-to-business platform will use J.P. Morgan's blockchain and tokenised dollar and euro deposits to speed up cross-border payments, CNBC reported.

events.title: Mastercard and Circle bring USDC and EURC settlement to EEMEA
events.summary: Mastercard introduced its first stablecoin settlement capability in Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa with Circle, letting acquirers and issuers in the region settle card transactions in USDC and EURC.

events.title: Citi and Swift complete fiat-to-digital currency settlement trial
events.summary: Citi and Swift completed a trial showing that payments can settle between fiat and digital currencies through synchronised settlement, using Swift messaging to bridge the two.

events.title: Mastercard Move adds stablecoin wallet payouts through Thunes
events.summary: Mastercard and Thunes announced at the Singapore Fintech Festival that Mastercard Move will make near real-time payouts to stablecoin wallets through Thunes' Direct Global Network.

events.title: Hercle and Lightspark add instant bitcoin payouts in euros and pounds
events.summary: Hercle became the first partner of Lightspark Grid in Europe, offering payment firms, fintechs and institutions instant settlement from bitcoin into euros and British pounds across the EU and the UK.

events.title: FDIC prepares guidance on deposit insurance for tokenised deposits
events.summary: The FDIC's chair confirmed the agency is drafting guidance on how deposit insurance applies to tokenised deposits, to help banks that issue them on blockchains.

events.title: Circle unveils StableFX engine and partner stablecoins on Arc
events.summary: Circle announced StableFX, an institutional stablecoin FX engine on Arc's public testnet, and Circle Partner Stablecoins, a programme for local-currency stablecoins issued by partners, to move FX settlement on-chain.

events.title: Cardano Foundation partners with Brale on compliant stablecoins
events.summary: The Cardano Foundation partnered with stablecoin issuance platform Brale to bring compliant stablecoin tools to builders and enterprises on Cardano.

events.title: BNY launches a reserve fund for stablecoin issuers
events.summary: BNY launched a regulated money market fund for stablecoin issuers to hold reserves under US rules, with Anchorage Digital providing the initial investment.

events.title: Thunes launches account top-ups and withdrawals for crypto platforms
events.summary: Thunes launched account top-up and withdrawal services so major digital asset platforms can run on- and off-ramp transactions through its network, backed by its compliance and treasury systems.

events.title: Nebraska issues first digital asset bank charter to Telcoin
events.summary: Nebraska's governor and banking regulator issued a charter to Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under the state's Financial Innovation Act, letting it run a stablecoin and digital asset business.
events.regulator: Nebraska Department of Banking and Finance

events.title: Rain buys on-chain rewards platform Uptop
events.summary: Stablecoin card platform Rain acquired Uptop, which turns card spending into loyalty rewards for brands and sports teams, so partners can issue branded cards and wallets with built-in rewards.

deal.rationale: rewards inside branded card and wallet programmes

events.title: Monerium links its euro stablecoin to Finery Markets' liquidity
events.summary: Monerium integrated with Finery Markets so its EURe euro stablecoin can tap institutional liquidity and cross rates with USDC and USDT.

events.title: Sui launches native stablecoin USDsui issued by Bridge
events.summary: The Sui blockchain unveiled USDsui, a native dollar stablecoin issued by Stripe's Bridge and designed to meet the GENIUS Act.

events.title: UAE completes its first government payment in Digital Dirham
events.summary: The UAE's Ministry of Finance and Dubai Finance made the first government transaction in the Digital Dirham, the central bank's digital currency, in under two minutes, as the country readies rules for stablecoins and digital money.

events.title: Transak adds six US state money transmitter licences
events.summary: Transak secured money transmitter licences in Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, South Carolina, Vermont and Pennsylvania, widening its regulated reach for stablecoin payments in the US.

events.title: Standard Chartered backs DCS's DeCard stablecoin credit card
events.summary: Standard Chartered became principal banking partner for DeCard, DCS Card Centre's credit card for spending stablecoins, providing transaction banking and financial markets services in Singapore.

events.title: J.P. Morgan's Kinexys and DBS link up on tokenised deposit transfers
events.summary: Kinexys by J.P. Morgan and DBS plan an interoperability framework linking their blockchains so tokenised deposits can move between the banks around the clock for cross-border settlement.

events.title: ClearToken wins FCA approval for CT Settle digital asset settlement
events.summary: London-based ClearToken won FCA authorisation to launch CT Settle, a delivery-versus-payment system for crypto, stablecoins and fiat that removes pre-funding, modelled on CLS in foreign exchange.

events.title: BVNK and Coinbase call off takeover after due diligence
events.summary: Coinbase and UK stablecoin payments firm BVNK mutually ended talks on a deal valued around $2B after reaching due diligence; BVNK, which says it handles over $20B a year, had also discussed a sale with Mastercard.

deal.rationale: talks ended after due diligence

events.title: Bank of England consults on rules for systemic sterling stablecoins
events.summary: The Bank of England published a consultation paper setting out its proposed regime for sterling-denominated systemic stablecoins.

events.title: Paystand buys stablecoin payouts platform Bitwage
events.summary: B2B payments network Paystand, which has processed over $20bn for more than 1,000 enterprises, acquired Bitwage to add stablecoin settlement, FX and international payroll to its platform.

deal.rationale: stablecoin settlement and payouts for enterprise customers

events.title: Tempo leads $25m round in blockchain infrastructure firm Commonware
events.summary: Tempo, the payments blockchain launched by Stripe and Paradigm, led a $25m round in Commonware, which builds blockchain infrastructure for real-world payments. Other investors were not named.

events.title: Arx Research raises $6.1m seed for its Burner stablecoin terminal
events.summary: Arx Research raised a $6.1m seed round led by Castle Island Ventures with Inflection, Placeholder, Seed Club Ventures and 1kx to launch Burner Terminal, a point-of-sale device for stablecoin and card payments.

round.use_of_funds: launching its Burner Terminal point-of-sale device

events.title: Ripple raises $500m at a $40bn valuation led by Fortress and Citadel
events.summary: Ripple raised $500m in a strategic round led by Fortress Investment Group and Citadel Securities, with Pantera and Galaxy Digital, at a $40bn valuation, after a $1bn tender offer at the same price. Its payments platform has moved over $95bn.

events.title: Canada's Budget 2025 proposes a federal stablecoin law
events.summary: Canada's 2025 federal budget announced legislation for fiat-backed stablecoin issuers, with the Bank of Canada as overseer, covering reserves, redemption and risk management, plus about C$10m over two years to run it.

events.title: Ripple buys wallet provider Palisade for its custody business
events.summary: Ripple acquired Palisade, whose wallet-as-a-service platform joins Ripple Custody to give fintechs and corporates fast wallets for on- and off-ramps and payments. It was Ripple's fourth deal of 2025 after Hidden Road, Rail and GTreasury.

deal.rationale: fast wallet infrastructure for institutional custody and payments

events.title: Dutch AFM authorises zerohash under MiCA for EEA-wide services
events.summary: The AFM authorised zerohash europe as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider, letting the US infrastructure firm provide embedded crypto and stablecoin services to business clients across the EEA from the Netherlands.

events.title: New UAE central bank law pulls crypto payments into CBUAE licensing
events.summary: CoinDesk reported that Federal Decree Law No. 6 of 2025, enacted in Sept and made public in Nov, extends CBUAE licensing to virtual-asset payments, DeFi and related infrastructure, giving existing firms until Sept 2026 to comply.

events.title: Cash App announces stablecoin support alongside bitcoin payments
events.summary: Block's Cash App said it will add stablecoin support and let customers pay with bitcoin over Lightning without holding it, as part of its first bundled release of new features.

events.title: Coinbase in late-stage talks to buy BVNK for about $2bn
events.summary: Coinbase was in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin infrastructure firm BVNK for about $2bn, Bloomberg reported, aiming to finish late in 2025 or early 2026; Coinbase Ventures was already a BVNK investor. Coinbase declined to comment.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments infrastructure

events.title: Visa adds four stablecoins on four chains as card spend quadruples
events.summary: Visa said it will support four more stablecoins across four blockchains, after spending through stablecoin-linked cards quadrupled year on year to over $2.5bn in annualised run rate.

events.title: Flutterwave picks Polygon for stablecoin payments across Africa
events.summary: Flutterwave will use the Polygon network as the default rails for its new stablecoin payment system, starting with multinational clients such as Uber and Audiomack, across more than 30 African countries.

events.title: Mastercard in late-stage talks to buy zerohash for up to $2bn
events.summary: Mastercard was in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin infrastructure firm zerohash for $1.5bn to $2bn, Fortune reported; zerohash had raised $104m in September led by Interactive Brokers. Mastercard had earlier held talks with BVNK.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments infrastructure

events.title: Hercle raises $10m led by F-Prime plus a $50m credit facility
events.summary: Hercle, which gives payment providers and commodity traders stablecoin-based global money transfers and says it has processed over $20bn, raised a $10m equity round led by F-Prime and a $50m credit facility for expansion.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion

events.title: FASB opens a project on accounting for stablecoins
events.summary: The Financial Accounting Standards Board voted 6-1 to add stablecoin accounting to its technical agenda, after the President's digital asset working group asked it to consider treating stablecoins as cash equivalents.

events.title: Italy's Bancomat plans EUR.bank, a euro stablecoin for 2026
events.summary: Bancomat, the Italian payment network, unveiled EUR.bank, a euro stablecoin due in 2026 for cheap cross-border payments and the settlement of tokenised assets.

events.title: Western Union plans USDPT stablecoin on Solana with Anchorage
events.summary: Western Union plans to roll out USDPT, a US dollar payment token issued by Anchorage Digital on Solana, for its payment network of 100m users in the first half of 2026.

events.title: Loon raises C$3m to take over the CADC Canadian-dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Calgary-based Loon, spun out of Paytrie, raised C$3m in pre-seed funding led by Version One Ventures with Garage Capital and is acquiring Paytrie's CADC stablecoin, which moved over $200m on Base this year, to build it into a regulated token.

round.use_of_funds: a regulated Canadian-dollar stablecoin

events.title: IBM launches Digital Asset Haven with Dfns for institutions
events.summary: IBM announced Digital Asset Haven, built with wallet provider Dfns, for banks, governments and corporations to manage digital assets across more than 40 blockchains while meeting compliance obligations.

events.title: Circle opens Arc public testnet with over 100 institutions
events.summary: Circle deployed the public testnet of Arc, its blockchain with dollar-based fees and sub-second settlement, with over 100 financial and technology firms taking part, including BlackRock, Visa, HSBC and AWS.

events.title: Zelle's parent plans stablecoin-powered international transfers
events.summary: Early Warning Services, which runs Zelle, said it will use stablecoins to let users send money across borders, citing clearer US rules after the GENIUS Act.

events.title: USBC plans US Bank Coin tokenised deposit with Vast Bank and Uphold
events.summary: NYSE-listed USBC unveiled US Bank Coin, a dollar tokenised deposit for retail users on a permissioned blockchain. Vast Bank will launch it first in 2026, with exchange Uphold distributing it to its users.

events.title: Vantage Bank and Custodia offer tokenised deposits to US banks
events.summary: Vantage Bank and Custodia invited US banks and credit unions to join a consortium offering tokenised deposits and stablecoins inside online banking. Tokens can switch between deposit and stablecoin status under oversight.

events.title: Transak taps Cross River for faster fiat rails in the US
events.summary: Cross River Bank will process fiat payments for Transak, including ACH, wires and instant rails such as RTP and FedNow, to speed up settlement for the on-ramp's consumer and business users.

events.title: Revolut wins MiCA licence in Cyprus and adds 1:1 stablecoin swaps
events.summary: Revolut received MiCA authorisation from Cyprus's CySEC to offer crypto services across 30 EEA markets, alongside new 1:1 conversions between US dollars and stablecoins and zero-fee staking.

events.title: Pave Bank raises $39m led by Accel for programmable banking
events.summary: Pave Bank, which joins traditional banking with regulated digital assets, raised $39m led by Accel with Tether Investments, Quona Capital, Wintermute and others, taking its total funding past $44m.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion, regulatory footprint and institutional banking infrastructure

events.title: Fireblocks buys wallet developer platform Dynamic
events.summary: Fireblocks acquired Dynamic, whose wallet and onboarding tools power over 50m on-chain accounts for firms including Kraken and zerohash, to offer a custody-to-consumer stack; Fortune later put the price at about $90m.

deal.rationale: a custody-to-consumer stack for fintechs and enterprises

events.title: Toronto's Cybrid raises $10m Series A for stablecoin payment rails
events.summary: Cybrid, a Toronto firm whose API combines stablecoin and fiat payments with compliance, raised a $10m Series A led by BDC Capital's Growth Venture Fund with Golden Ventures, Luge Capital and Panache Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: bringing stablecoin payments to more enterprises and Canadian financial institutions

events.title: Blockchain.com wins MiCA licence from Malta's MFSA
events.summary: Blockchain.com obtained a MiCA licence from the Malta Financial Services Authority, letting it offer institutional crypto products in 30 EEA countries as it expands in Europe.

events.title: SG-FORGE authorised as a MiCA crypto-asset service provider
events.summary: France's AMF register lists SG-FORGE as a MiCA CASP for custody and transfers from 23 October 2025, with order execution added by extension in February 2026.

events.title: Zepz launches the Sendwave Wallet on USDC and Solana
events.summary: Zepz, the remittance group behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, launched the Sendwave Wallet, putting stablecoins in users' hands with Circle's USDC, Solana and wallet provider Portal; Sendwave already serves over a million users.

events.title: Switzerland proposes stablecoin and crypto institution licences
events.summary: Switzerland's Federal Council opened a consultation, running to 6 February 2026, on new payment instrument institution licences covering stablecoins and crypto institution licences, under direct FINMA supervision.

events.title: Modern Treasury buys stablecoin payments start-up Beam
events.summary: Modern Treasury, valued at $2.1bn, acquired stablecoin and fiat payments platform Beam in an all-stock deal worth about $40m, a source told Fortune, to add stablecoin settlement to its payment operations software.

deal.rationale: stablecoin orchestration alongside traditional payment rails

events.title: ESRB flags stablecoin risks and targets third-country multi-issuers
events.summary: The European Systemic Risk Board published a report on crypto risks, focused on stablecoins, and issued a recommendation on stablecoins issued jointly by EU and non-EU entities, warning of vulnerabilities as crypto ties to finance grow.

events.title: Borderless.xyz launches an open benchmark for stablecoin FX rates
events.summary: Borderless.xyz launched the Borderless Benchmark, an open reference for stablecoin-to-fiat exchange rates such as USDC, USDT and EURC against local currencies, built on its network of regulated on- and off-ramp providers.

events.title: Market maker B2C2 launches PENNY for zero-fee stablecoin swaps
events.summary: Institutional liquidity provider B2C2 launched PENNY, a zero-fee platform for instant swaps between major stablecoins including USDT, USDC and PYUSD across several blockchains.

events.title: Tesser raises $4.5m seed to give banks and PSPs stablecoin payments
events.summary: New York-based Tesser, founded in 2025 by a former MoneyGram, Visa Direct and Circle executive, raised $4.5m led by Castle Island Ventures with Strobe Ventures and Anthemis for a full-stack stablecoin platform for licensed institutions.

round.use_of_funds: launching its platform for banks and PSPs

events.title: Fed's Waller floats 'skinny' master accounts for payment firms
events.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller asked staff to explore a 'payment account' giving eligible institutions focused on payments basic access to Fed rails, with no interest, balance caps, no overdrafts and no discount window.

events.title: Stripe-incubated Tempo raises $500m at $5bn valuation
events.summary: Payments blockchain Tempo, incubated by Stripe and Paradigm, raised a $500m Series A at a $5bn valuation led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks. Stripe and Paradigm did not invest in the round.

events.title: Ripple buys treasury software firm GTreasury for $1bn
events.summary: Ripple agreed a $1bn acquisition of GTreasury, a treasury management system provider, opening the corporate treasury market and its large corporate clients to Ripple's payments and digital asset services.

deal.rationale: enter corporate treasury and reach large corporate clients

events.title: French bank ODDO BHF launches EUROD, a MiCA euro stablecoin
events.summary: ODDO BHF, the Franco-German financial group, launched EUROD, a euro stablecoin built to comply with MiCA, with a listing on Madrid-based crypto platform Bit2Me, whose backers include Telefónica, Unicaja and BBVA.

events.title: Erebor wins conditional OCC approval for a national bank charter
events.summary: The OCC granted conditional national bank status to Erebor, a tech-sector bank aiming to serve crypto and venture-backed companies. The regulator said the decision shows it is open to digital asset activity at the banks it oversees.

events.title: Bitpanda offers SG-FORGE's euro and dollar stablecoins to retail users
events.summary: SG-FORGE and Bitpanda widened their partnership so Bitpanda's DeFi wallet offers SG-FORGE's EUR and USD CoinVertible stablecoins to retail users across Europe for the first time, with on-chain lending and borrowing.

events.title: Legend Trading wins MiCA licence in Ireland and launches Legend FXN
events.summary: Legend Trading was authorised as a crypto-asset service provider by the Central Bank of Ireland under MiCA and unveiled Legend FXN, a regulated stablecoin-to-fiat settlement hub.

events.title: Ten global banks explore reserve-backed tokens in G7 currencies
events.summary: Ten of the world's largest banks, including Bank of America, Santander, BNP Paribas, Citi, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs, said they will explore issuing 1:1 reserve-backed digital money on public blockchains in G7 currencies.

events.title: Brussels declines ECB push to restrict multi-issuance stablecoins
events.summary: The European Commission signalled on 10 October that it would not add restrictions on stablecoin firms that treat tokens issued inside and outside the EU as interchangeable, rejecting the ECB's call for tighter MiCA rules.

events.title: Routefusion raises $26.5m Series A for cross-border payment rails
events.summary: Austin-based Routefusion, which links fragmented payment rails for cross-border transfers through one API, raised a $26.5m Series A led by PeakSpan Capital with Silverton Partners, taking its total to $40.7m.

round.use_of_funds: partner network, liquidity and compliance

events.title: Citi Ventures invests in BVNK, valuing it above $750m
events.summary: Citi Ventures made a strategic investment of undisclosed size in London-based BVNK, pushing its valuation above $750m, its co-founder told CNBC, months after Visa Ventures backed the firm.

round.use_of_funds: scaling stablecoin payment infrastructure globally

events.title: Bank of North Dakota plans Roughrider Coin stablecoin with Fiserv
events.summary: The state-owned Bank of North Dakota will launch Roughrider Coin, a dollar stablecoin for banks and credit unions in the state, in 2026. It runs on Fiserv's digital asset platform and its white-label FIUSD system.

events.title: Coinflow raises $25m Series A led by Pantera for stablecoin payouts
events.summary: Chicago-based Coinflow, whose infrastructure lets businesses accept and send money with stablecoins such as USDC in 170+ countries, raised a $25m Series A led by Pantera Capital with Coinbase Ventures, after growing revenue 23-fold since 2024.

round.use_of_funds: payout coverage in Asia and Latin America, hiring and approval rates

events.title: U.S. Bank to hold reserves behind Anchorage's payment stablecoins
events.summary: U.S. Bank, with $11.7tn in custody, was chosen to hold the reserves backing the GENIUS Act-compliant payment stablecoins Anchorage Digital Bank began issuing in July 2025.

events.title: Labuan FSA gives Fasset conditional approval for a stablecoin Islamic digital bank
events.summary: Labuan's regulator gave Fasset Islamic Digital Bank Limited a conditional approval in its Islamic digital bank sandbox; it may not start business until it meets every operational and prudential requirement. Fasset had described it as a Malaysian banking licence.

events.title: Sony Bank applies to the OCC for Connectia Trust
events.summary: Sony Bank applied to the OCC on 6 October to set up Connectia Trust, a limited-purpose national trust bank in New York focused on crypto, positioning it to issue a dollar stablecoin under federal oversight.

events.title: Brex adds stablecoin payments for its business customers
events.summary: Brex, with over 30,000 business clients, added sending and receiving USDC with automatic conversion to dollars for international payments, and lets companies top up corporate cards with stablecoins.

events.title: Paxos Labs and Aleo launch USAD, a private dollar stablecoin
events.summary: Paxos Labs and the Aleo Network Foundation launched USAD, a dollar stablecoin that encrypts transaction data end to end, aimed at institutions that want private, programmable digital dollars.

events.title: Saudi minister says stablecoins are under discussion with SAMA and CMA
events.summary: Housing minister Majid Al-Hogail said the government is discussing stablecoins with the central bank and the Capital Market Authority. Unlock reported this as talks, not a decision.

events.title: DeFi Technologies makes strategic investment in Stablecorp
events.summary: DeFi Technologies made a strategic investment in Stablecorp, joining Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures and Side Door Ventures as backers of the QCAD Canadian-dollar stablecoin.

round.use_of_funds: scaling QCAD adoption

events.title: Abu Dhabi's M2 Capital invests $20m in Ethena
events.summary: UAE-based M2 Capital invested $20m in Ethena, whose USDe synthetic dollar and yield-bearing sUSDe had drawn over $14bn since 2024, and plans to add Ethena products to its wealth management services.

events.title: RedotPay raises $47m with Coinbase Ventures and passes $1bn value
events.summary: RedotPay, founded in 2023, which offers stablecoin cards, multicurrency wallets and payouts, raised a $47m strategic round with Coinbase Ventures, Galaxy Ventures and Vertex Ventures, and said it is now valued at over $1bn.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion

events.title: Cloudflare plans NET Dollar stablecoin for AI agent payments
events.summary: Cloudflare announced NET Dollar, a US dollar-backed stablecoin for instant, global online payments and microtransactions by AI agents; CEO Matthew Prince said stablecoin payments could replace ads and bank transfers.

events.title: Stablecorp raises about C$5m led by FTP Ventures for QCAD
events.summary: Toronto-based Stablecorp, which runs the QCAD Canadian-dollar stablecoin, raised about C$5m in a follow-on round led by FTP Ventures with existing and new shareholders, after a round earlier in 2025 led by Coinbase Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: rolling out QCAD

events.title: Circle Ventures makes strategic investment in Crossmint
events.summary: Circle Ventures made a strategic investment in Crossmint, which combines its wallets and APIs for stablecoin on-ramps, orchestration and agent payments with USDC.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin payments for fintechs, enterprises and AI agents

events.title: Bastion raises $14.6m led by Coinbase Ventures
events.summary: Bastion, which provides regulated stablecoin issuance, reserve and liquidity services, raised $14.6m led by Coinbase Ventures with Sony Innovation Fund, a16z crypto, Samsung Next and Hashed, taking its total past $40m.

round.use_of_funds: adoption of its stablecoin products

events.title: zerohash raises $104m at a $1bn valuation led by Interactive Brokers
events.summary: Crypto and stablecoin infrastructure firm zerohash raised a $104m Series D-2 at a $1bn valuation led by Interactive Brokers, with Morgan Stanley, Apollo-managed funds, SoFi, Jump Crypto and others, taking total funding to $275m.

events.title: Tether in talks to raise up to $20bn at a $500bn valuation
events.summary: Tether was reported to be seeking $15bn to $20bn for about 3% of the company in a private placement, valuing it near $500bn. The talks were early, with investors given data-room access; it reported $4.9bn of second-quarter profit.

events.title: Fnality raises $136m Series C with Bank of America and Citi
events.summary: Fnality, which runs the central bank-regulated Sterling Fnality Payment System, raised $136m led by WisdomTree, Bank of America, Citi, KBC, Temasek and Tradeweb, with Santander, Barclays, Goldman Sachs, UBS and other existing backers.

round.use_of_funds: more currencies, better liquidity management and links to stablecoins and tokenised deposits

events.title: PayPal Ventures invests in USDT chain Stable, adding PYUSD
events.summary: PayPal Ventures invested in Stable, a layer-1 blockchain powered by USDT, which is bringing PayPal USD onto its network. It follows Stable's $28m seed round backed by Bitfinex and Hack VC.

round.use_of_funds: PYUSD distribution and liquidity

events.title: Shield raises $5m seed for cross-border trade payments in stablecoins
events.summary: Shield, which lets exporters and importers pay across borders in dollar stablecoins with compliance screening, raised a $5m seed led by Giant Ventures with a16z crypto's accelerator and Factor Capital, having processed over $100m.

round.use_of_funds: more banking partnerships

events.title: Brale raises $30m led by Lightspeed
events.summary: Stablecoin issuance platform Brale raised $30m led by Lightspeed with NEA, Refract and angels from Cloudflare, Rain, Tempo and Coinflow, to fund research, regulatory work and incubation and acquisitions at Brale Holdings.

round.use_of_funds: research and development, regulatory work, incubation and M&A

events.title: Stablecore raises $20m led by Norwest to bring stablecoins to banks
events.summary: Dallas-based Stablecore, founded in 2025, raised $20m led by Norwest Venture Partners, with Coinbase Ventures, Curql, BankTech Ventures, Bank of Utah, EJF Ventures and funds representing over 290 banks and credit unions.

round.use_of_funds: letting community and regional banks and credit unions offer stablecoins and tokenised deposits

events.title: MoonPay buys payments start-up Meso
events.summary: MoonPay acquired payments start-up Meso, confirming the deal on X, to help build what it called crypto's largest global payments network. No financial terms were given; it follows MoonPay's $175m purchase of Helio in January.

deal.rationale: a global crypto payments network

events.title: Gemini raises $425m in its IPO at a $3.3bn valuation
events.summary: Crypto exchange Gemini priced its IPO at $28 a share, above a range it had already raised, selling 15.2m shares for $425m at a value of about $3.3bn. Nasdaq agreed to buy $50m of its stock in a private placement.

events.title: dLocal joins the Fireblocks Network for fiat-stablecoin rails
events.summary: Emerging-markets payments firm dLocal joined the Fireblocks Network for Payments, giving institutions a partner for on- and off-ramps and easier access to liquidity providers among more than 2,400 participants.

events.title: Tetra raises C$10m from banks and fintechs for a CAD stablecoin
events.summary: Tetra Trust's new parent, Tetra Digital Group, closed C$10m of equity from Urbana, ATB Financial, National Bank, Purpose, Shakepay, Shopify and Wealthsimple to launch a Canadian-dollar stablecoin; about 30% was secondary for early investors.

round.use_of_funds: a Canadian-dollar stablecoin and its Tetra Unity software

events.title: Lead Bank raises $70m Series B led by ICONIQ and Greycroft
events.summary: Lead Bank, a state-chartered bank providing banking infrastructure to fintechs and digital asset firms, raised $70m led by ICONIQ and Greycroft with Ribbit Capital, Coatue, Khosla Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz and Zeev Ventures.

events.title: Utila adds $22m Series A extension led by Red Dot
events.summary: Red Dot Capital Partners led a $22m extension of Utila's Series A, with Nyca, Wing VC, DCG, Cerca Partners, Funfair Ventures and SilverCircle, taking the round to $40m and total funding past $51m; Utila says its valuation nearly tripled.

events.title: Kite raises $18m for stablecoin payments by AI agents
events.summary: San Francisco-based Kite, which gives AI agents verified identities, spending rules and stablecoin payment rails, raised an $18m Series A co-led by General Catalyst and PayPal Ventures, taking its total to $33m.

round.use_of_funds: tools for agents to transact at machine speed

events.title: Rain raises $58m Series B led by Sapphire Ventures
events.summary: Rain raised a $58m Series B led by Sapphire Ventures, with Dragonfly, Galaxy, Endeavor Catalyst, Samsung Next, Lightspeed and Norwest, five months after its Series A, taking its total to $88.5m; volume had grown 10x since January.

round.use_of_funds: hiring in engineering, commercial and compliance teams, scaling partner programmes and entering new markets

events.title: M0 raises $40m Series B led by Polychain and Ribbit
events.summary: M0, which builds infrastructure that lets many issuers mint interoperable stablecoins, raised $40m of equity and locked tokens led by Polychain and Ribbit Capital, with Endeavor Catalyst, Pantera and Bain Capital Crypto; it has raised almost $100m.

round.use_of_funds: its stablecoin network for issuers

events.title: Tazapay closes Series B with Ripple and Circle as investors
events.summary: Singapore cross-border payments platform Tazapay closed a Series B led by Peak XV with Ripple, Circle Ventures, Norinchukin Capital and GMO VenturePartners. Licensed in Singapore, Canada and the EU, it is applying in the UAE and the US.

round.use_of_funds: licences in more markets, including the UAE, the US and Hong Kong

events.title: Circle buys the Malachite consensus engine to power its Arc chain
events.summary: Circle acquired Malachite, the consensus engine set to underpin its Arc payments blockchain, from Informal Systems, including the technology and IP; nine Informal Systems staff joined Circle. Terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: consensus technology for the Arc blockchain

events.title: Transak raises $16m led by Tether and IDG Capital
events.summary: On- and off-ramp provider Transak, which has processed over $2bn with nearly 30% in stablecoins, raised $16m co-led by Tether and IDG Capital with Primal Capital, 1kx, Fuel Ventures and others to expand its stablecoin payments stack.

round.use_of_funds: its stablecoin payments stack and new markets

events.title: Ripple agrees to buy stablecoin payments platform Rail for $200m
events.summary: Ripple agreed to acquire Rail, a stablecoin-based global payments platform, for $200m, to offer a complete stablecoin payments service to businesses.

deal.rationale: a complete stablecoin payments service

events.title: USDT chain Stable raises $28m seed led by Bitfinex and Hack VC
events.summary: Stable, a layer-1 blockchain powered by USDT, closed a $28m seed led by Bitfinex and Hack VC with Franklin Templeton, Castle Island Ventures, Susquehanna Crypto and others, to grow its infrastructure and USDT distribution.

round.use_of_funds: infrastructure, staff and USDT distribution

events.title: Plasma's XPL public sale draws $373m against a $50m target
events.summary: Stablecoin chain Plasma closed a 10-day public sale of its XPL token with $373m of commitments from over 2,900 wallets, more than seven times its $50m target, at a $500m valuation.

events.title: Zodia Markets raises $18.25m Series A for stablecoin payments push
events.summary: Zodia Markets, the crypto trading firm majority-owned by Standard Chartered, raised $18.25m led by Pharsalus Capital with Circle Ventures, The Operating Group and XVC Tech, for international expansion and stablecoin payment services.

round.use_of_funds: international expansion and stablecoin payment services

events.title: Spiko raises $22m led by Index Ventures for tokenised cash funds
events.summary: French start-up Spiko, which issues tokenised money market funds, raised $22m led by Index Ventures, with angels including Revolut's Nikolay Storonsky and Wise CTO Harsh Sinha. It held almost $400m after less than a year.

events.title: Kraken makes strategic investment in StablR
events.summary: Kraken made an undisclosed strategic investment in StablR, whose EURR and USDR stablecoins are listed on more than 50 exchanges and passed $3bn of transaction volume in the first half of 2025.

events.title: Trump signs the GENIUS Act, the first US stablecoin law
events.summary: President Trump signed the GENIUS Act, the Senate's stablecoin bill as passed by the House, into law, creating a federal regulatory framework for dollar-backed payment stablecoins.

events.title: Dakota raises $12.5m Series A led by CoinFund for stablecoin banking
events.summary: Dakota, a stablecoin-powered business banking platform co-founded by former Coinbase executive Ryan Bozarth, raised a $12.5m equity Series A led by CoinFund with 6th Man Ventures, Triton Ventures and Digital Currency Group.

events.title: Agora raises $50m Series A led by Paradigm
events.summary: Agora, issuer of the AUSD dollar stablecoin and a white-label issuance service, raised a $50m Series A led by Paradigm, a year after a $12m seed round.

round.use_of_funds: growing AUSD and white-label issuance

events.title: Monad Foundation buys stablecoin wallet platform Portal
events.summary: The Monad Foundation acquired Portal Labs, whose embedded wallets let businesses and banks accept stablecoin payments. Portal CEO Raj Parekh, formerly of Visa, becomes Monad's head of payments and stablecoins.
