deal.rationale: stablecoin payments on the Monad blockchain

events.title: Canton builder Digital Asset raises $135m led by DRW and Tradeweb
events.summary: Digital Asset, which builds the privacy-focused Canton Network, raised $135m co-led by DRW Venture Capital and Tradeweb with BNP Paribas, Circle Ventures, Citadel Securities, DTCC, IMC, Virtu and Paxos.

round.use_of_funds: bringing more real-world assets onto Canton

events.title: Stablecoin clearing start-up Ubyx raises $10m led by Galaxy
events.summary: Ubyx, founded by former Citi executive Tony McLaughlin to clear stablecoins through regulated banks, raised a $10m seed led by Galaxy Ventures with Coinbase Ventures, Founders Fund, Paxos and VanEck.

round.use_of_funds: a global stablecoin clearing system

events.title: Stripe agrees to buy wallet infrastructure firm Privy
events.summary: Stripe agreed to buy Privy, whose embedded wallets serve over 75m accounts and 1,000 developer teams, its second major crypto deal after Bridge. Privy will run as an independent product; terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: embedded crypto wallets for Stripe's stablecoin products

events.title: London's OpenTrade raises $7m for stablecoin yield products
events.summary: OpenTrade, which gives fintechs yield-bearing stablecoin products backed by real-world assets, raised $7m co-led by Notion Capital and Mercury Fund with a16z crypto, AlbionVC and CMCC Global, taking its total to $11m.

round.use_of_funds: yield-bearing stablecoin products in Latin America and Europe

events.title: Noah raises $22m seed led by LocalGlobe and adds Adyen's Thijn Lamers
events.summary: Stablecoin payments start-up Noah raised a $22m seed led by LocalGlobe with Felix Capital, FJ Labs and angels including Joe Lonsdale, as former Adyen executive Thijn Lamers joined as president and co-founder.

events.title: Turnkey raises $30m Series B led by Bain Capital Crypto
events.summary: Wallet infrastructure firm Turnkey, which powers more than 50m embedded wallets with secure key management, raised $30m led by Bain Capital Crypto with Sequoia, Lightspeed Faction, Galaxy Ventures, Wintermute Ventures and Variant.

events.title: Limited raises $7m seed led by North Island Ventures
events.summary: Self-custody stablecoin banking start-up Limited raised a $7m seed led by North Island Ventures, with Third Prime, Arche Capital, Collab+Currency and SevenX Ventures, taking its total to $10m.

round.use_of_funds: growth in Latin America, South-East Asia and the Middle East

events.title: Circle raises $1.05bn in upsized NYSE listing
events.summary: USDC issuer Circle priced its twice-upsized IPO at $31 a share, raising $1.05bn and valuing the company at about $8.06bn, ahead of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

events.title: Velocity emerges with $10m pre-seed led by Activant
events.summary: London's Velocity, founded by Tom Greenwood and Eric Queathem, raised a $10m pre-seed led by Activant Capital, with Fuel, Triton, Fabric, Commerce, Digital Space and Preface, and launched a Stablecoin Payment Account.

round.use_of_funds: platform development and global expansion

events.title: Conduit raises $36m Series A co-led by Dragonfly and Altos
events.summary: Boston-based Conduit, which runs cross-border payments on stablecoins alongside local rails, raised a $36m Series A co-led by Dragonfly and Altos Ventures, with Circle Ventures and Digital Currency Group among the backers.

round.use_of_funds: expanding its global payment rails

events.title: Founders Fund makes strategic investment in Plasma
events.summary: Founders Fund made a strategic investment in Plasma, the stablecoin blockchain, to help it grow its team and ecosystem in regions from Latin America to the Middle East. Peter Thiel was one of Plasma's earliest angel investors.

round.use_of_funds: team, ecosystem and adoption in Latin America and the Middle East

events.title: Catena Labs raises $18m led by a16z crypto for an AI-native bank
events.summary: Catena Labs, led by Circle co-founder Sean Neville, raised $18m led by a16z crypto to build a regulated financial institution for AI agents, using regulated stablecoins such as USDC as its money.

round.use_of_funds: a regulated financial institution for AI agents

events.title: Anchorage Digital to buy USDM issuer Mountain Protocol
events.summary: Federally chartered crypto bank Anchorage Digital agreed to buy Mountain Protocol, issuer of the USDM stablecoin, to support institutional stablecoin adoption. Terms were not disclosed and the deal needs regulatory approval.

deal.rationale: institutional stablecoin issuance

events.title: Visa makes strategic investment in BVNK
events.summary: Visa invested an undisclosed sum in London stablecoin payments infrastructure firm BVNK through Visa Ventures, five months after BVNK's $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures.

events.title: Fuze raises $12.2m Series A co-led by Galaxy and e& capital
events.summary: UAE-based Fuze, which supplies digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure to banks, fintechs and firms in the Middle East and Turkey, raised $12.2m co-led by Galaxy and e& capital, with Further Ventures, for expansion, products and hiring.

round.use_of_funds: regional and international expansion, product development, compliance and hiring

events.title: OpenFX emerges with $23m led by Accel for round-the-clock FX
events.summary: OpenFX came out of stealth with a $23m round led by Accel, with Castle Island Ventures and Hash3, to run instant cross-border payments around the clock. It claimed $10bn of annualised payment volume already.

events.title: Circle turns down a $4bn to $5bn takeover offer from Ripple
events.summary: Ripple, issuer of the RLUSD stablecoin, offered $4bn to $5bn to buy USDC issuer Circle, Bloomberg reported. Circle rejected the offer as too low while it prepared to go public.

deal.rationale: Circle rejected the offer as too low

events.title: Swapped.com buys Web3 payments firm Kado Software
events.summary: Crypto on-ramp Swapped.com acquired Kado Software, a Web3 payments infrastructure provider, on undisclosed terms. Kado founder Emery Andrew leads Swapped's US operations and product expansion.

deal.rationale: a larger US presence and new crypto-native payment products

events.title: Ripple buys prime broker Hidden Road for $1.25bn
events.summary: Ripple agreed to buy Hidden Road, a prime broker offering clearing and financing across FX, digital assets, derivatives and fixed income, for $1.25bn, becoming the first crypto firm to own a global multi-asset prime broker.

deal.rationale: institutional prime brokerage, with RLUSD used as collateral

events.title: Codex raises $15.8m seed led by Dragonfly for a stablecoin chain
events.summary: Codex, which is building a blockchain designed for stablecoins, raised a $15.8m seed of equity and token warrants led by Dragonfly, which put in about $14m, with the venture arms of Coinbase and Circle.

round.use_of_funds: a blockchain built for stablecoin payments

events.title: Damisa raises £2.25m pre-seed for stablecoin payments and escrow
events.summary: Damisa, a payments platform co-founded by Volt's Jordan Lawrence, raised £2.25m led by Fuel Ventures with EWOR and Greyhound Capital; its first customer uses Damisa's wallets in place of escrow services.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin payment and escrow wallets

events.title: Rain raises $24.5m Series A led by Norwest
events.summary: Stablecoin card issuer Rain raised $24.5m led by Norwest Venture Partners, with new backers Galaxy Ventures, Goldcrest, Thayer and Hard Yaka joining Lightspeed, Coinbase Ventures and other existing investors.

round.use_of_funds: more interoperability with existing rails, a wider footprint and its stablecoin authorisation and settlement infrastructure

events.title: NymCard raises $33m Series B led by QED Investors
events.summary: Dubai card-issuing and embedded finance platform NymCard raised $33m led by QED Investors, its first Gulf investment, with Lunate, Dubai Future District Fund, Mashreq Bank, Shorooq, Oraseya Capital and others, taking its total to nearly $70m.

round.use_of_funds: deeper presence across 10+ MENA markets

events.title: Utila raises $18m Series A as stablecoin demand lifts MPC wallets
events.summary: Utila, which runs MPC wallets and digital asset operations for payment firms, fintechs and neobanks, raised an $18m Series A led by Nyca Partners. It said it processed $8bn in a month and will expand globally.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion, gas management, API integrations and smart contract support

events.title: Stable Sea exits stealth with $3.5m for corporate stablecoin flows
events.summary: Stable Sea came out of stealth with a $3.5m raise for an orchestration platform that gives corporate treasurers a fiat off-ramp and a dashboard for cross-border stablecoin payments, routing data rather than holding funds.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin orchestration for corporate treasurers

events.title: Wallet infrastructure firm Privy raises about $15m led by Ribbit
events.summary: Privy, whose APIs let apps give users crypto wallets, raised an estimated $15m led by Ribbit Capital with Sequoia, Paradigm, BlueYard and Coinbase, taking its total funding past $40m.

round.use_of_funds: crypto onboarding rails for developers

events.title: Crossmint raises $23.6m led by Ribbit Capital
events.summary: Crossmint, which sells one platform for wallets, stablecoins and payments to businesses and AI agents, raised $23.6m led by Ribbit Capital. It holds a virtual asset service provider licence and has a MiCA licence under way.

round.use_of_funds: bringing businesses and AI agents on-chain

events.title: RedotPay raises $40m Series A led by Lightspeed
events.summary: Hong Kong crypto card and payments platform RedotPay, founded in 2023, raised a $40m Series A led by Lightspeed, with HSG, Galaxy Ventures, DST Global Partners, Accel and Temasek-backed Vertex Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: a wider payment ecosystem, new products, stronger compliance and more licences

events.title: MoonPay buys stablecoin infrastructure platform Iron
events.summary: MoonPay acquired Iron, an API-first stablecoin infrastructure platform, to offer businesses multi-currency treasury, instant cross-border payments and yield, after buying Solana payment processor Helio. Iron later became MoonPay Enterprise.

deal.rationale: enterprise stablecoin treasury and cross-border payments

events.title: Abu Dhabi's MGX invests $2bn in Binance, paid in a stablecoin
events.summary: Abu Dhabi investment firm MGX invested $2bn in Binance, paid in a stablecoin. It was the exchange's first institutional investment and MGX's first digital-asset deal; Binance has around 1,000 staff in Abu Dhabi.

events.title: Mesh raises $82m Series B led by Paradigm, settled in PYUSD
events.summary: Crypto payments network Mesh closed an $82m Series B led by Paradigm, with Consensys, QuantumLight and Yolo Investments, paid largely in the PYUSD stablecoin, taking its total raised past $120m.

round.use_of_funds: building out its global crypto payments network

events.title: Dubai's Mansa raises $10m seed led by Tether for stablecoin liquidity
events.summary: Dubai-based Mansa, which lends payment companies stablecoin liquidity on a revolving line, raised $10m: a $3m equity round led by Tether with Faculty Group, Octerra, Polymorphic and Trive Digital, plus $7m of liquidity.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin liquidity for payment companies' settlement and pre-funding

events.title: Plasma raises $24m to build a blockchain for stablecoins
events.summary: Plasma raised $24m in its first round, led by Framework Ventures with Bitfinex, Peter Thiel and Tether chief executive Paolo Ardoino, to launch a blockchain built for fast, zero-fee USDT transfers.

round.use_of_funds: launching the Plasma blockchain

events.title: Limited raises $3m pre-seed for stablecoin-based banking
events.summary: Limited, founded by Hussein Ahmed to offer premium global banking services on stablecoins with self-custody, raised a $3m pre-seed led by Third Prime, with The House Fund and Arche Capital.

events.title: Stripe completes its acquisition of Bridge
events.summary: Stripe completed its purchase of stablecoin platform Bridge, which it had agreed to buy in October 2024; Bridge co-founder Zach Abrams confirmed the close.

deal.rationale: build stablecoin payments into Stripe

events.title: Bastion gains a New York trust charter by buying Dibbs Trust Company
events.summary: Stablecoin infrastructure firm Bastion secured a New York limited purpose trust charter from NYDFS by acquiring Dibbs Trust Company, to launch a white-label stablecoin issuance platform.

events.title: QED leads $9.9m seed in stablecoin payments firm Cedar Money
events.summary: US-based Cedar Money, which runs cross-border payments on stablecoins behind a fiat-facing service, raised a $9.9m seed led by QED Investors with Lattice, NIV, Stellar and Wischoff Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: scaling its payment infrastructure

events.title: Circle buys Hashnote, issuer of the USYC tokenised money fund
events.summary: Circle acquired Hashnote, issuer of USYC, then the largest tokenised treasury and money market fund with $1.52bn deployed, and agreed a strategic partnership with DRW affiliate Cumberland.

deal.rationale: a tokenised money market fund to sit beside USDC in capital markets

events.title: Phantom raises $150m Series C at a $3bn valuation
events.summary: Crypto wallet Phantom raised $150m in a Series C led by Sequoia Capital and Paradigm at a $3bn valuation. It claimed 15m active users and $20bn of annual trading volume.

round.use_of_funds: new features for its wallet, including social discovery

events.title: Komainu raises $75m Series B from Blockstream, paid in bitcoin
events.summary: Custodian Komainu, backed by Nomura's Laser Digital, raised $75m from Blockstream Capital Partners, funded in bitcoin, to speed international growth and adopt Blockstream technology for collateral management and tokenisation.

round.use_of_funds: international growth and Blockstream technology for collateral management and tokenisation

events.title: 1Money emerges with over $20m seed for a stablecoin payments chain
events.summary: 1Money came out of stealth with more than $20m of seed capital, with Hack VC among its backers, to launch the 1Money Network, a layer 1 protocol built for stablecoin payments that it planned to open in the second quarter.

round.use_of_funds: launching the 1Money Network

events.title: MoonPay buys Solana payment processor Helio for $175m
events.summary: MoonPay acquired Helio, a Solana-based crypto payment processor serving over 6,000 merchants with more than $1.5bn of transactions, in a $175m deal to widen its payments offering for merchants and marketplaces.

deal.rationale: crypto payments for merchants and marketplaces

events.title: Tether invests in European stablecoin issuer StablR
events.summary: Tether made an undisclosed investment in StablR, issuer of the EURR and USDR stablecoins, saying it backs fully regulated stablecoins in Europe as a wave of euro token launches gets under way.

events.title: BVNK raises $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures
events.summary: London stablecoin payments firm BVNK raised a $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures, with Coinbase Ventures, Scribble Ventures, DRW Venture Capital and existing investors Avenir and Tiger Global, and set out plans to expand in the US in 2025.

round.use_of_funds: growth, including expansion in the US

events.title: KAST raises $10m seed led by HSG and Peak XV
events.summary: KAST, a stablecoin platform offering payment cards and US dollar accounts in over 150 countries with partners such as Bridge, raised a $10m seed led by HSG and Peak XV, with partners of DST Global and Goodwater Capital.

round.use_of_funds: savings and remittance products on top of its cards and dollar accounts

events.title: Paxos agrees to buy Finnish e-money institution Membrane Finance
events.summary: Paxos agreed to buy Membrane Finance, a Finnish e-money institution, to become a fully licensed EMI in Finland and the EU and issue MiCA-compliant stablecoins for European clients, subject to regulatory approval.

deal.rationale: an EU e-money licence to issue MiCA-compliant stablecoins

events.title: Tether, Kraken and Fabric back Quantoz as it issues EURQ and USDQ
events.summary: Utrecht-based Quantoz Payments took investment from Fabric Ventures, Kraken and Tether as it began issuing EURQ and USDQ, euro and dollar tokens designed to comply with MiCA, on Ethereum, with listings planned on Bitfinex and Kraken.

events.title: Emirates NBD to join Partior for dirham, riyal and rupee settlement
events.summary: Emirates NBD agreed to join Partior's blockchain clearing and settlement network as its first UAE dirham, Saudi riyal and Indian rupee settlement bank, also acting for major foreign currencies, and is weighing an equity investment through its innovation fund.

events.title: Stripe agrees to buy stablecoin platform Bridge for a reported $1.1bn
events.summary: Stripe confirmed it is buying Bridge, founded in 2022 by Coinbase alumni, in a deal reported at $1.1bn and subject to regulatory approval. Bridge said it had processed $5bn a year since launch, with clients including SpaceX.

deal.rationale: build stablecoin payments into Stripe

events.title: SCB launches stablecoin remittances on Lightnet, with Fireblocks
events.summary: Siam Commercial Bank, Thailand's oldest bank, began offering round-the-clock stablecoin cross-border payments and remittances through Lightnet, on Fireblocks infrastructure, after testing the service in the Bank of Thailand's regulatory sandbox.
